name: A Hush Falls Over the World
description: Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn. Creatures in your waking world become hidden to imprecise hearing or concealed to precise hearing. A creature in your waking world attempting to use spell or effect with the auditory or sonic trait must succeed at a DC 4 flat check; on a failure, the spell or effect is disrupted. Anytime a creature in the area is affected by an auditory or sonic effect, they must attempt a DC 16 flat check. On a success, they are not affected by the auditory or sonic effect, though they still may be affected by other aspects of an ability (for example, a creature hit by a weapon with a thundering rune would not take sonic damage but would still take the normal damage from the weapon).

name: Advanced Death Dealing
description:
You gain one necromancer feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your necromancer level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another necromancer feat.

name: Advanced Martial Magic
description:
You gain one magus feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your magus level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another magus feat.

name: Advanced Rune Magic
description:
You gain a runesmith feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your runesmith level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another runesmith feat.

name: Advanced Synergy
description:
You gain one summoner feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your summoner level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another summoner feat.

name: Advanced Weaponry
description: Your eidolon’s attack evolves. Choose one of your eidolon’s starting melee unarmed attacks to gain one of the following traits, chosen when you gain the feat: disarm; grapple; nonlethal; shove; trip; or versatile B, P, or S.

name: Aerial Flash
description: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you. You teleport to any square within 60 feet that's within reach of a creature, then make a melee Strike against that creature. After this Strike, you teleport back to your prior position.

name: Aether Beam
description: You can open your internal nexus, unleashing a destructive beam of magical energy that emanates from your hand, eyes, or chest. You fire a beam that deals 6d6 force damage in a 60- foot line and pushes back anyone who stands within. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save against your nexus DC. A creature that fails is also pushed back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical failure). The damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Aether Blast
description: You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast. You direct the blast at one creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d12 force damage with a basic Reflex save against your nexus DC. The force damage increases by 1d12 at 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Afterimage
description: You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square. This afterimage looks like you and can perform simple behaviors to make the deception more plausible but otherwise cannot move or take actions. A creature can distinguish between you and your afterimage easily. Your afterimage automatically fails all checks and DCs and is destroyed if it would take any damage; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute. Whenever you take the Step action, you can instead teleport to an afterimage instead. If you do, the action gains the teleportation trait, and the afterimage you teleport to is destroyed.

name: Airborne Form
description: Your eidolon can fly. They gain a fly Speed equal to their Speed.

name: Alacritous Action
description: Your eidolon moves more quickly. Your eidolon’s Speed increases by 10 feet.

name: All Returns to Slumber
description:
Your waking world returns to slumber, and lays the peace of deep sleep on all within it. You Dismiss your waking world, and all creatures in the area must attempt a Will save against your world rouser DC. Animals, beasts, and plants native to this world treat the result of their save as one degree worse. Creatures in the area then become temporarily immune to this ability for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature can’t use reactions for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also slowed 1.

name: Amalgamate
description: You create a single mighty abomination using the pieces of two expendable thralls. You destroy two of your thralls within 30 feet that are adjacent to each other, fusing them into an amalgamation. An amalgamation is a single Large thrall with a reach of 10 feet and a Speed of 25 feet. It gains a status bonus to damage rolls on its Strikes equal to your level.

name: Amphibious Form
description: Your eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater. They gain the amphibious trait, allowing them to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal –2 penalty for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes underwater. They gain a swim Speed equal to their land Speed or 25 feet, whichever is less; if they’re normally aquatic, they gain a land Speed equal to their swim Speed or 25 feet, whichever is less.

name: Analyze Magic
description:
Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air. You gain the Analyze Magic spellshift.

Spellshift—Analyze Magic Once you’ve homed in on a spell or magical effect, you can study its unique magical signature to immediately understand exactly what it does.

Critical Success You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had critically succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

Success You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

name: Anatomical Quartering
description: You briefly separate into four forms that share your space. One is made of blood, one of bones, one of flesh, and one of spirit. Make up to four Strikes, each against a different target. All physical damage from the final Strike instead becomes spirit damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don’t increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

name: Annihilating Compound Invocation
description: Each tradition of magic holds sway over two of the four essences that make up all of creation, and so by invoking runes from each tradition at once, you can pull from the four corners of magic to unravel anything. You invoke four runes of your choice, each of which must be from a different tradition of magic. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of all invoked runes must attempt a basic Fortitude saving throw, taking 10d4 force damage on a failure as destructive magical reverberations clash in their body. If reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage or by the damage of any of the runes invoked, the creature’s body is torn apart into glowing script that describes the creature to the smallest detail, leaving no remains as the letters fade. The creature’s gear is unharmed.

name: Arcane Fists
description: Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms. The damage die for your fist changes to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don’t take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attacks. Your unarmed attacks gain the arcane trait, making them magical. At 5th level, you also gain the critical specialization effects of unarmed attacks in the brawling group and weapons in the brawling group, using your spell DC instead of class DC.

name: Arcane Shroud
description:
Your magic has a powerful aftereffect, briefly granting you a certain spell. When you take this feat, choose three of false vitality, fleet step, invisibility, mountain resilience, resist energy, and see the unseen.

When you use Arcane Cascade, choose one of the spells you selected with this feat. You’re affected by this aftereffect spell until the end of your next turn, though it ends early if the stance ends or another circumstance ends it (such as if you take a hostile action while affected by invisibility). If you’re 18th level or higher, a false vitality or resist energy you get from Arcane Shroud is heightened to 4th rank.

Special You can select this feat a second time to add the remaining spells to your set of choices.

name: Artist's Attendance
description: Your runes call you to better attend to your art. Stride twice. If you end your movement within reach of a creature that is bearing one of your runes, you can Trace a Rune upon that creature or another target adjacent to you. You can use Artist’s Attendance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

name: Astral Compound Invocation
description:
Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes. You Invoke two Runes; one must be an arcane rune, and one must be an occult rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the compound invocation.

Success The target is stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.

Failure The target is stupefied 2 until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target is stupefied 3 until the end of your next turn.

name: Awake With a Roar
description:
When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting. All enemies in the area must attempt a Will save against your world rouser DC. A creature that attempts this save or observes this ability becomes temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is frightened 1.

Failure The creature becomes frightened 2 and stunned 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes frightened 3 and stunned 1.

name: Backup Runic Enhancement
prerequisites: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
description: While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic. You can cast the sigil cantrip as an innate spell at will. In addition, choose either runic body or runic weapon. You can cast this spell once per day as an innate spell. The rank of these spells is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least trained in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine).

name: Basic Captivator Spellcasting
description:
Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full‑fledged spellcasting. This spellcasting comes naturally and instinctively to you rather than as a product of training. Choose a 1st-rank occult spell that has the illusion or mental trait. You can cast this spell as an innate occult spell. At 6th level, you gain a 2nd-rank occult spell, and at 8th level you gain a 3rd-rank occult spell. These spells must also each have either the illusion or mental trait.

Captivating Intensity, Countercharm, Expert Captivator Spellcasting

name: Basic Death Dealing
description:
You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.

Advanced Death Dealing

name: Basic Hedge Mage Spellcasting
description:
Your independent introspections grant you rudiments of magical power. You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the hedge mage archetype, add three common 1st‑rank spells to your keepsake. Your keepsake can also hold 1st-rank spells.

Cantrip Supremacy, Expert Hedge Mage Spellcasting, Simple Mastery

name: Basic Magus Spellcasting
description:
You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the magus archetype, add two common spells of that rank or lower to your spellbook.

Expert Magus Spellcasting

name: Basic Martial Magic
description:
You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level magus feat of your choice.

Advanced Martial Magic

name: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting
description:
You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the necromancer archetype, add two common spells of that rank or lower to your dirge.

Expert Necromancer Spellcasting

name: Basic Rune Magic
description:
You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level runesmith feat.

Advanced Rune Magic

name: Basic Summoner Spellcasting
description:
You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. Your key spellcasting attribute for summoner archetype spells is Charisma, and they are summoner spells of your eidolon’s tradition. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. You gain a spell repertoire and two cantrips. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the summoner archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire.

Expert Summoner Spellcasting

name: Basic Synergy
description:
You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level summoner feat of your choice.

Advanced Synergy

name: Beckoning Dirge
description: Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet. This turn, you can Cast one Spell that’s in your dirge without spending a spell slot or even having it prepared. The maximum rank of this spell is 1 rank lower than your highest-rank necromancer spell slot. The chosen thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell, and you calculate range and cover from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

name: Become as Spirit
description: You can move through an unwilling creature’s spaces as if they were difficult terrain. Additionally, you ignore natural difficult terrain and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape attempts. Whenever you destroy a thrall, you gain resistance to all damage (except force, ghost touch, spirit, or vitality) equal to half your level for 1 round.

name: Beguiling Aura
description: You channel your manipulative magic to subtly give off mental signals that either drive enemies away or draw them closer. You gain a 30-foot aura that lasts for 1 minute. When an enemy within your aura fails a saving throw against one of your innate captivator spells, you can also have them Step in a direction of your choice, though they must remain within your aura. You can’t choose to have a creature Step into hazardous terrain, off a ledge, or the like.

name: Bind Heroic Spirit
description:
You bind the spirit of a dead hero into you, gaining some of their talent. You learn the bind heroic spirit grave spell.

Final Union

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. While in the frenzy, your eidolon is affected by boost eidolon and gains temporary HP equal to your level, but takes a –1 penalty to AC. The temporary HP last until the frenzy ends. They can’t voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy. The frenzy lasts for 1 minute or until your eidolon is no longer manifested, whichever comes first, after which your eidolon can’t start another frenzy for 1 minute.

name: Blood Pool
description: You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies. You pool the blood of the creature on the ground in a space adjacent to the triggering creature, infusing it with healing properties. The pool lasts for 1 minute or until absorbed by an ally. When an ally enters a space with a blood pool, they can absorb the blood pool as a free action, regaining Hit Points equal to your level.

name: Bloodletting Claws
description:
Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow. If your eidolon critically hits with a melee unarmed Strike that deals slashing or piercing damage, their target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage. Your eidolon gains an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the unarmed attack’s item bonus to attack rolls. This is a critical specialization effect.

Blood Frenzy

name: Bloody Tendrils
description: You create three immobile tendrils made of blood that lash out at your enemies. You learn the bloody tendrils grave spell.

name: Blossoming Gore
description: You create a field of bloody roses. You learn the blossoming gore grave spell.

name: Bodily Disintegration
description:
You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material. You focus on your physical body and will the parts of it to disassemble momentarily. You Stride. You can pass through creatures and tiny cracks during this movement. You cannot pass through solid walls or magical boundaries such as a wall of force. If you haven’t completely passed through a creature or object by the end of your movement, you take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and are shunted to the nearest spot that you can occupy.

Enhancement When you use Bodily Disintegration, you can move through solid walls and delay fully reassembling your body, causing you to become concealed until the start of your next turn.

name: Body Shield
description: You throw an adjacent thrall in between you and the attacker. The thrall grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack still hits, you gain resistance to the triggering attack’s damage equal to your level. Regardless of the result, the thrall is destroyed.

name: Bone Burst
description:
You destroy the thrall in an explosion of bone shards that fly toward the triggering creature, dealing 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

The damage increases to 3d10 at 12th and to 4d10 at 18th level.

name: Bone Speaker
description:
To truly understand the mechanical advantages of an undead skeleton, you must understand how it functioned in life. You can Recall Knowledge on living creatures with an internal or external skeleton using Undead Lore. If you do, you can learn only information pertaining to the biology of a creature—not any learned abilities or abilities granted by items.

Additionally, you can perform a forensic examination on a corpse using Undead Lore instead of Medicine if the corpse came from a creature with a skeleton.

name: Bony Barrage
description: You launch a massive barrage of tiny bones. You learn the bony barrage grave spell.

name: Boost Summons
description: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon. When you cast boost eidolon, in addition to your eidolon, it also targets your summoned creatures within 60 feet.

name: Bridge of Graves
description: You create a massive line of grave dirt that thralls can easily traverse. You learn the bridge of graves grave spell.

name: Burning Cascade
description: Energy flares out around you when you drop into your signature stance. When you use Arcane Cascade, each enemy in a 5-foot emanation takes damage equal to the extra damage from Arcane Cascade. This damage is the same type as that of Arcane Cascade. A creature that takes this damage is temporarily immune to further uses of Burning Cascade for 1 minute.

name: Burrowing Form
description: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt. Your eidolon gains a burrow Speed of 15 feet.

name: By Your Name
description:
In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name. Attempt a Crafting check against a standard DC of the target creature’s level. Regardless of the outcome, you can’t attempt to use By Your Name against the target again for 24 hours.

Critical Success You understand the target’s runic name and temporarily learn how to write their name as a special diacritic rune. This diacritic rune magnifies the effects of the base rune when targeting the named creature. When the rune is invoked, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw against the effects of the base rune, and if the base rune deals damage, it gains a status bonus to its damage equal to half your level. The inspiration used to understand this diacritic rune fades quickly, and you forget how to use the diacritic rune after 1 minute.

Success As critical success, but the rune doesn’t grant a bonus to damage.

name: Calcification
description: You attempt to turn a creature into pure bone. You learn the calcification grave spell.

name: Cantrip Supremacy
description: You know more than most how useful even the simplest of spells can be during the course of a day. Add 10 additional cantrips to your keepsake. You can also prepare 10 additional cantrips from your keepsake each day.

name: Captivating Intensity
description: Your ability to captivate others has grown, and you can use your captivator abilities more often. You seem to never run out of the ability to fascinate or distract. You can cast each innate occult spell granted by captivator archetype feats one additional time per day, except for your two highest-ranked captivator spells.

name: Captivator Dedication
prerequisites: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy
description:
Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural. You’re seldom at a loss in social situations, and you can create minor charms or illusions. Choose Deception or Diplomacy. You become trained in that skill or become an expert if you were already trained.

Choose two cantrips from the occult list. Each cantrip must have the illusion trait, mental trait, or both. You can cast these spells as innate occult spells.

Basic Captivator Spellcasting, Beguiling Aura, Effortless Captivation, Heightened Captivation, Look Again, Reactive Charm

name: Capture Magic
description: When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use. You enter your Arcane Cascade stance, using the triggering spell to determine what damage type your Arcane Cascade deals. Alternatively, if you’re already in Arcane Cascade, you can instead amplify its effects temporarily. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 status bonus to the extra damage and resistance you gain from your Arcane Cascade.

name: Cascading Ray
description: Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck. The flowing energy forms a ray with a range of 120 feet originating from the creature you damaged. You can’t target any of the creatures you damaged with your Spellstrike with the ray. Make a spell attack against the new target’s AC, at the same multiple attack penalty as the Strike. On a hit, the target of the ray takes 1d4 damage per spell rank of the spell you used for Spellstrike, or 1d8 damage per rank if you cast the spell from a spell slot. The ray uses the same damage type as the spell dealt (choose one if it dealt more than one type of damage). This ray has the attack trait, the tradition trait of the original spell, and the trait matching the damage type.

name: Chain of Words
description:
You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another. You Invoke two Runes within 60 feet. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, a chain of glowing script flows between them, dealing 5d6 force damage to all creatures in a straight line between them with a basic Reflex saving throw; creatures bearing the invoked runes are not in the area of this line. A creature who critically fails its save is also immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes, as the runes seal its movements. The DC to Escape is your class DC.

At 12th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

name: Clashing Compound Invocation
description:
As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash. You Invoke two Runes, which must be from opposed traditions of magic; either 1 arcane and 1 divine rune, or 1 occult and 1 primal rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must also attempt a Fortitude saving throw as destructive magical harmonics clash.

Success The target is sickened 1, but if it spends a single action attempting to recover, it automatically succeeds.

Failure The target is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target is sickened 2.

name: Collateral Reinforcement
description: With a combination of bony armor, extra flesh layers, and tactical incorporeal phasing, you protect your thralls from collateral damage. For 1 round, your thralls become immune to area and splash damage.

name: Come in From the Wilderness
description: A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth. For each source of persistent damage it is taking, the creature can immediately attempt a flat check to recover, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance. While swallowed, the creature becomes paralyzed and cannot be targeted or affected by any new effects (ongoing effects, such as afflictions or persistent damage, continue to affect it as normal). At the start of your next turn, the creature regains 6d8 Hit Points and emerges in its previous location. If another creature is in that location, it is pushed to the nearest available space. The target creature then becomes temporarily immune to this ability until your next daily preparations.

name: Community Needs
description: You have learned to take the time needed to be flexible and to contemplate the best use of your magic for those around you. You can spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spell slots and prepare a different spell from your keepsake in its place. If you’re interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.

name: Conflux Focus
description: You imagine how you’ll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus. Whenever you Refocus, you completely refill your focus pool.

name: Conglomerate of Limbs
description: You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs. You learn the conglomerate of limbs grave spell.

name: Conjurer of Corpses
description: You can call forth many kinds of undead to do your bidding. You learn the summon undead spell. Undead creatures you summon with this spell can be destroyed and targeted by your spells or abilities as if they were thralls. You gain an additional spell slot each day at your highest level of necromancer spell slots. You can prepare only the summon undead spell in this slot.

name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
description: You can make yourself resistant to damaging spells. You learn the conjurer’s countermeasure conflux spell.

name: Constricting Hold
description: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon’s level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

name: Contingency Leap
description: When imperiled by a fall, you swiftly transport yourself out of danger. You teleport to any edge or handhold in range, stopping your fall. If your destination is one you couldn’t normally stand on (such as a handhold), you must succeed at your choice of an Acrobatics check or a Reflex save, usually at the Climb DC, as Grab an Edge, but you take no damage unless you critically fail.

name: Corrupted Ground
description: The ground on which you stride is mere fuel that you burn with unholy void energies, scarring the earth in your wake. When a holy creature or psychopomp ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes 2 spirit damage. If it’s a holy living creature, it takes an additional 2 void damage. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the spirit and void damage each increase by 2. Corrupted Ground lasts for 1 minute, but you can Dismiss it.

name: Countercharm
description: Your charms and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others. When a foe casts a spell with the illusion or mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own innate magic to disrupt it. You lose an innate, non-cantrip spell with the same trait as the triggering spell as if you had cast the spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

name: Dance of Bloody Ink
description: As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target’s flesh. You Invoke a Rune on a melee weapon you are wielding and Strike. Then, you can Step and Strike again with the same weapon. If the second Strike hits, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

name: Dart Between
description: In the blink of an eye, you transport yourself and any items you’re wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you’re carrying it in an extradimensional container—you cannot Dart Between. When you arrive at your destination, you can Part the Veil as a free action, even if you wouldn’t normally meet its requirements. If you are hidden, this action does not cause you to become observed provided you still have cover, greater cover, or concealment from the creatures you were hidden from after the teleportation.

name: Dazzling Block
description:
As your shield blocks an assault, you create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC, with the following effects.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end this blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

name: Death Speaker
description: Your voice and magic speak to the core existence within undead creatures, circumventing the need for the creature to comprehend. Your spells and abilities ignore the mindless trait and any immunity to emotion, fear, or mental effects when targeting or affecting undead creatures. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to Make an Impression on and make a Request of an undead creature.

name: Deathly Scream
description: A thrall’s scream mentally harms and frightens your foes. You learn the deathly scream grave spell.

name: Defend Summoner
description: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you. After your eidolon uses this action, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus applies only while you’re within your eidolon’s reach (in most cases, this means your eidolon is adjacent to you or in your space).

name: Define the Canvas
description: You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas. The canvas is a 20-foot burst on the ground centered on a corner in your space. As long as you’re in or adjacent to the canvas, you can Trace a Rune directly into the ground, which causes the rune to expand across the entire space, tracing it onto any number of eligible targets within the area. The canvas lasts for 1 minute.

name: Desperate Revival
description:
On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. Each creature in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC. You regain Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt, up to a maximum of half your maximum Hit Points.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes void damage equal to half its level.

Failure The target takes void damage equal to its level.

Critical Failure The target takes void damage equal to double its level.

name: Desperate Surge
description:
You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations. You can attempt to Grab, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a creature using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

You can recharge this ability early by making an unarmed Strike to destroy one of your thralls within your reach.

name: Devastating Manifestation
description: Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them. You Manifest Soulforged Armament. If you manifested a weapon, make up to two Strikes with that weapon, each targeting a different creature and each dealing an additional 1d6 spirit damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn’t increase until you have made all your attacks. If you Manifested an armor or shield, you gain resistance 5 to all damage until the start of your next turn. If you manifested both a weapon and an armor or shield, you gain both effects.

name: Devastating Spellstrike
description:
Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they smash into nearby foes. Make a Spellstrike with a spell that can deal damage. Enemies in a 5-foot emanation around the target (not including the target) take 2 damage of the same damage type your spell could deal. This damage increases to 3 at 9th level, 4 at 14th level, and 5 at 19th level.

If you’re in the Arcane Cascade stance, the emanation’s damage gains a status bonus to damage equal to the extra damage from your Arcane Cascade.

name: Diacritic Fluency
description:
When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed. The next time you Trace a Rune this turn, you can also Trace a diacritic Rune on that rune.

Shades of Meaning

name: Dimensional Disappearance
prerequisites: _dimensional assault_ focus spell,; laughing shadow hybrid study
description: You take advantage of certain idiosyncrasies of teleportation magic to better hide your position. When you cast dimensional assault, you’re affected by an invisibility spell at the end of the teleport. You can choose not to make the Strike that is normally part of dimensional assault. If you do make the Strike, your invisibility ends after the Strike, as normal for invisibility.

name: Dimensional Pilfer
prerequisites: Veil Dancer Dedication; Expert in Stealth
description: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners’ noses. Attempt a Thievery check to Palm an Object or Steal an object you can see within 60 feet. If you are veiled, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. If you succeed, the object vanishes from its current location and appears on your person.

name: Dismantle Spell
description:
Your innate power can shut down other magic. You gain the Dismantle Spell spellshift.

Spellshift—Dismantle Spell You attempt to counteract a spell or at least suppress its effect for a time.

Critical Success The spell is counteracted if its rank is no more than 1 higher than half your level rounded up.

Success The effects of the spell are suppressed until the start of your next turn. If the spell has a duration that is measured in rounds, its duration is extended by 1 round. If the spell does not have a duration, it targets the same creature or area as though it had just been cast at the start of your next turn.

name: Dispelling Spellstrike
description: The spell you deliver tries to force out magic affecting your enemy. Make a Spellstrike. If it hits, you also attempt to counteract a single spell of your choice that is active on the target. The counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and the counteract check modifier is the standard modifier for counteracting with a spell (your Intelligence modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus, plus any bonuses or penalties that specifically apply to counteract checks).

name: Distant Invocation
description: Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances. You add 30 feet to the range of any of your invocation abilities (typically increasing the range from 30 to 60 feet).

name: Distracting Spellstrike
description:
You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike. Make a Spellstrike and Feint against the target of your Strike. Execute your Feint immediately before making the Strike, but after choosing your target. The Feint gains the arcane and visual traits, and it always has the basic effects of a Feint, rather than applying any adjustments or alternate effects from other feats or abilities.

If you're in the Arcane Cascade stance, you gain a status bonus to your Deception check equal to your extra damage from Arcane Cascade (typically 1, increasing to 2 if you have weapon specialization and 3 if you have greater weapon specialization).

name: Dizzying Spell
description: Your spell leaves a foe’s head spinning and unable to concentrate. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a Will saving throw and targets a single creature, the target is stupefied 2 for 1 round if it fails its saving throw (or stupefied 3 on a critical failure).

name: Draining Strike
description:
You draw the life out of your target using both your weapon and your thralls as a conduit. Make a Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. On a success, you can destroy a thrall that is within 10 feet of you or your target to have your Strike deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage. You regain Hit Points equal to the spirit damage dealt.

At 10th and 18th level, you can destroy up to one additional thrall as part of this action to deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage for each additional thrall destroyed.

name: Drawn in Vital Ink
description: After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood. For the next minute, you can Trace a Rune targeting the creature you drew blood from at a range of 60 feet (even if you’re Tracing a Rune as a single action). Using Drawn in Vital Ink against a different creature requires you to wipe off the blood already on your weapon, ending the effect for the previous creature.

name: Dread Mosquito Storm
description: You release a massive swarm of deadly bloodsuckers. You learn the dread mosquito storm grave spell.

name: Dual Energy Heart
description: A second energy dwells in your eidolon. Choose an additional damage type from the list in Energy Heart. Your eidolon’s unarmed attack that deals energy damage gains the versatile trait for the second energy damage type, and your eidolon gains resistance to the second type of energy damage equal to half your level.

name: Dual Studies
description: You and your eidolon learn different skills. Choose two skills. Your eidolon becomes trained in one of those skills, and you become trained in the other skill. At 7th level, you each become an expert in the chosen skills. Unlike other skill proficiencies, these proficiencies are not shared between you and your eidolon.

name: Dust Cloud
description: Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight. All creatures within your waking world become concealed, and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it until the start of your next turn. In addition, a creature that ends its turn in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your world rouser DC as it inhales the particles. On a failure, it is dazzled until the end of its next turn or blinded on a critical failure.

name: Ectoplasmic Aura
description: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm. Additionally, any enemy that ends its turn in this aura must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC. On a failure, it can’t use reactions until the start of its next turn. You can Dismiss this aura.

name: Edifying Trace
description: When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you. Trace a Rune onto an adjacent enemy and then attempt a skill check to Recall Knowledge about that target. If you succeed, you leverage this knowledge when you invoke any of your runes on that target; that target takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws against your invocations for 1 minute. If you use Edifying Trace on another enemy, the effect ends for the previous enemy.

name: Effortless Captivation
description: You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought. You Sustain an innate captivator spell.

name: Eidolon's Retort
description:
Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, your eidolon disrupts that action. This Strike doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn’t apply to this Strike.

Guiding Retort

name: Eidolon's Trample
description: Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter. They can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample. Your eidolon deals bludgeoning damage equal to the damage of their secondary attack against these creatures, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

name: Eidolon's Wrath
description: Your eidolon gains the eidolon’s wrath link spell, which they cast, instead of you. You determine the damage type when you gain the feat: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. As normal, your eidolon shares your Focus Points.

name: Elemental Defense
description: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has at least one element trait (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood), you gain resistance to effects that have the element traits of your spell equal to twice the spell’s rank. The resistance lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Elemental Revision
description: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels. You touch an adjacent corrosive, flaming, frost, shock, or thundering rune on an unattended item or one held or worn by a willing creature, and you change it to any other rune from that list. You can also revise the greater version of any of the above runes into the greater version of any other rune on the list (for instance, greater corrosive into greater frost). The revision lasts for 1 minute before the rune’s original magic reasserts itself.

name: Elemental Subsitution
description:
You can tamper with the elemental energy of a spell. You gain the Elemental Substitution spellshift.

Spellshift—Elemental Substitution Raw elemental energy is the fuel powering some of the most iconic spells of destruction ever devised, and you’ve discovered a method for realigning the magical pathways through which that energy flows into the material world.

Critical Success If the targeted spell inflicts acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, you change its damage type to your choice of one of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. If the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type for 1 minute, then returns to normal.

Success As critical success, except if the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type until the beginning of your next turn, then returns to normal.

name: Emergency Targe
description: You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield. The circumstance bonus applies to your defenses when determining the outcome of the triggering attack or spell.

name: Endless Return
description: You can return your enemies as thralls without a second thought. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for Inevitable Return.

name: Energy Heart
description:
Your eidolon’s heart beats with energy. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. One of their unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and they gain resistance to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).

Dual Energy Heart, Energy Resistance

name: Energy Resistance
description: Your eidolon has stronger resistance. Their resistance from Energy Heart and Dual Energy Heart increases to your level.

name: Engraving Maneuver
description: After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon. Attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip a target; your weapon must have the corresponding trait. If your skill check is successful, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike even if the target is pushed out of range.

name: Engraving Strike
description: You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact. Make a melee Strike with the weapon. On a success, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike

name: Enhance Spell
description: You attune your senses to the magical frequencies generated by an allied spellcaster, allowing you to amplify or modify their spells to suit the needs of the moment. Select one willing ally within 30 feet that you can see and choose one of the following spellshape feats: Conceal Spell, Nonlethal Spell, Reach Spell, or Widen Spell. The target gains the benefits of the feat on their next turn as though they had taken the spellshape action themselves; this requires them to Cast a Spell as their first action on their turn.

name: Enhanced Glyph Familiar
description: Your living rune is imbued with more magical power. You can select two familiar or master abilities each day instead of one. In addition, when you Trace a Rune with a single action, your target can be adjacent to your familiar instead of adjacent to you. Your familiar must be within 30 feet of you for this benefit.

name: Enhanced Undead Familiar
description: You infuse your undead familiar with void energy. You can select three familiar or master abilities each day, instead of one.

name: Eternal Boost
description: Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce their abilities. You are permanently quickened; you can use your extra action only to cast boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon. While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are also continually casting boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon even while using a different exploration activity. If you do, even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.

name: Ever-Vigilant Senses
description: Your eidolon has enhanced senses. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception and can’t be flanked except by creatures that are higher level than them. They can see invisible creatures and objects, which appear translucent and are concealed. When your eidolon moves within 30 feet of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check to disbelieve it, even if your eidolon didn’t spend an action to Interact.

name: Expanded Glossary
description: You have memorized more runes than many in your craft. Add two runes of 9th level or lower to your runic repertoire.

name: Expanded Necromancy
description: You delve into other magical traditions. Add the grisly growths spell to your dirge. Add the following spells to your dirge as soon as you gain the ability to cast necromancer spells of that rank: 7th: execute, 8th: desiccate, 9th: massacre. You can prepare and cast these spells as occult spells.

name: Expanded Repertoire
description: Your knowledge of runes grows. Add two runes of 5th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

name: Expanded Senses
description: Your eidolon evolves more acute senses. Your eidolon gains low-light vision and darkvision, as well as scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

name: Expansive Spellstrike
description: You can blast the energy of a spell out around the target of your attack. When you Spellstrike with a spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, the spell creates an area instead of affecting only the target. The target must be in the area, and Expansive Spellstrike has no effect if your spell was disrupted (such as if you critically fail your Strike). A burst is centered on any corner you choose of the target’s square (or the corner of any square in its space for a Large or larger creature). A cone or line emits from you and must include the target; if you’re not adjacent to the target (using a reach weapon or starlit span, for example), choose any square adjacent to the target as the source. The spell affects all creatures in the area as normal, but the Strike still targets only one creature.

name: Expert Captivator Spellcasting
description:
You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive. You learn a 4th-rank occult spell. At 12th level, you learn a 5th-rank spell, and at 14th level, you learn a 6th-rank spell. These spells must each have either the illusion or mental trait. You cast these spells as innate occult spells. You become an expert in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics.

Master Captivator Spellcasting

name: Expert Combat Eidolon
description: Your eidolon advances their capabilities in combat. Your eidolon becomes an expert in unarmed attacks. If you’re an expert in unarmored defense, your eidolon also becomes an expert in unarmored defense. If you have weapon specialization, your eidolon also gains weapon specialization.

name: Expert Hedge Mage Spellcasting
description:
You gain the expert spellcasting benefits. When you add spells to your keepsake from gaining a spell slot of a new rank from the hedge mage archetype, you can choose 2nd-rank spells. Your keepsake can also hold 2nd-rank spells.

Master Hedge Mage Spellcasting

name: Expert Magus Spellcasting
prerequisites: Basic Magus Spellcasting; Master in Arcana
description:
You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

Master Magus Spellcasting

name: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting
prerequisites: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting; Master in Occultism
description:
You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

Master Necromancer Spellcasting

name: Expert Summoner Spellcasting
prerequisites: Basic Summoner Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your eidolon’s tradition
description:
You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

Master Summoner Spellcasting

name: Exploding Bullet
description:
You load your gun with a bullet forged of magic instead of matter, barely contained in an arcane shell. Interact to reload your firearm, creating an arcane round made from your choice of fire or sonic energy. When you shoot this round, the Strike gains the arcane trait and the corresponding energy trait. The firearm gains the scatter 5 feet trait, or gains a +1 status bonus to its splash damage if it already has the scatter trait. The scatter trait’s splash damage uses the energy type you chose. The bullet disappears if not fired by the end of your next turn.

If your firearm takes more than 1 action to reload, you need to use Exploding Bullet for all the actions needed to reload it to get the benefits.

Special When you use volatile spark’s Reloading Cascade action, you can use Exploding Bullet instead of an Interact action to reload a firearm.

name: Expressive Face
description:
Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you are already trained in Diplomacy, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the Glad-Hand skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

Enhancement You are particularly skilled at pouring your heart out to others. You gain the Plaintive Plea action.

Plaintive Plea [single action] (fortune) Frequency once per day; Effect You make an emotional appeal to convince someone during a diplomatic encounter. If your next activity is to attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression or Request, or to attempt to influence a creature during an influence encounter, you can roll twice and take the better result.

name: Extend Boost
description: You can increase the duration of your eidolon’s boosts. You learn the extend boost link spell.

name: Fade Presence
description: You weave magic around you to mask your presence from observers. Once per hour each, you can cast invisibility and silence as innate 2nd-rank occult spells. You can target only yourself with these spells.

name: Final Spite
description: You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite. The triggering creature takes 4d4 persistent poison damage with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC. If the creature kills you or your ally as part of the trigger, the creature gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolls on this save.

name: Final Union
description:
You and the heroic spirit have formed an eternal pact and now share your body. You are constantly under the effect of a 10th-rank bind heroic spirit. You choose whether the heroic spirit remains as a separate entity bound to you or whether you become a fused spirit that lives in unison, possibly identifying as an entirely new person.

You gain the Additional Lore feat for a topic the spirit knew in life, usually Warfare Lore.

If you would fall unconscious, you don’t fall prone or drop any items. Instead, your heroic spirit takes control of your body, allowing you to perform actions as if you were still conscious. If you would die, your heroic spirit puppets your corpse for up to 1 minute after your death or until your body is destroyed. While dead, you are an undead object, granting you immunities to bleed, death effects, disease, healing, nonlethal attacks, poison, and void, as well as the doomed, drained, fatigued, sickened, and unconscious conditions. As an object, you have 200 Hit Points and a Broken Threshold of 100 Hit Points. While broken, you are slowed 1. If you are destroyed, your body must be mended before you can be brought back to life. A creature can spend 8 hours to attempt a DC 45 Crafting check, mending your body on a success. Alternatively, powerful magic such as the remake spell or the wish ritual can also be used to mend your body.

name: Flesh Tsunami
description: You unleash a wave of melted flesh. You learn the flesh tsunami grave spell.

name: Flexible Nexus
description: In bending the basic essences of magic around yourself, you have seen the ways they connect and flow into each other, changing from one to the next. Each time you use an ability granted by the Living Nexus archetype that deals force damage, you may change the damage type from force to mental, spirit, vitality, or void. The altered ability loses the force trait and gains the trait of the new damage type.

name: Flexible Transmogrification
description: You’ve learned how to transmogrify your eidolon to suit the circumstances of the day. Each day, choose one evolution feat of 6th level or lower during your daily preparations. Your eidolon gains that feat until your next daily preparations.

name: Force Fang
description: You can turn your attack into an unerring blur of force. You learn the force fang conflux spell.

name: Forge New Word
description:
At the pinnacle of your art, you have forged a new great rune of power, a new ideal expression or utterance to be added to the craft. You create a rune and add it to your runic repertoire. When you gain this feat, choose a spell of 4th rank or lower. It must be common, or you must otherwise have access to it. The spell must take 1 or 2 actions to cast. You can choose a variable action spell, deciding when you create the rune whether the rune uses the 1-action or 2-action version of the spell. Name your rune. This rune has the unique trait and a magical trait of your choosing (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

This rune can be drawn on a creature or object, regardless of what the spell can target. When invoked, this rune has the effect of the chosen spell. The rune-bearer is the point of origin for the spell’s effect; calculate range and cover from its space. If the spell has targets, you decide who or what the spell targets, and the rune-bearer is a possible target if your chosen spell can target it. If the spell can affect only you (such as translocate), invoking it affects only you, and has no effect if the rune is drawn anywhere other than on you. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, use your class DC – 10 in place of the spell attack modifier. If your chosen spell has a duration and that duration is longer than 1 minute, the invoked rune’s duration is 1 minute instead.

name: Fortifying Knock
description:
Your shield is a natural canvas for your art. In one motion, you Raise a Shield and Trace a Rune on your shield.

Runic Reprisal

name: Fused Staff
description:
You can use your arcane prowess to fuse a magical staff into a weapon during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait. The fusion lasts until you fuse the staff again or the weapon is out of your possession for 24 hours. The fused item has the staff’s activations and other benefits, and it can be used to cast spells if you prepare it. The staff and the weapon share their fundamental runes, using whichever weapon potency and whichever striking rune is higher level. If the staff has property runes, they’re suppressed while it’s fused.

The item’s fused abilities work for you alone. A different wielder can use the weapon normally, but they don’t get the benefit of the shared runes and can’t use the staff’s spells or abilities.

name: Generational Rune-Singer
description: You are a once-in-a-generation genius. You can Trace a Rune with song at will and at a range of 60 feet.

name: Ghostly Resonance
description: Your runes don’t just draw power from the world of the spirits— they can let even the most mundane objects harm spirits as well. When you etch or trace a divine or occult rune on a weapon or creature, you can grant it the ghost touch weapon property rune. For a weapon, this doesn’t count toward the weapon’s limit on property runes. For a creature, the rune applies to all unarmed Strikes the creature makes. This benefit lasts as long as the rune remains.

name: Ghostly Stride
description: You fade into a slightly incorporeal form as you move. You Stride up to half your Speed. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions, and you can move through enemies’ spaces during it. If you have a fly Speed, you can instead Fly up to half your fly Speed.

name: Glider Form
description:
Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent. They glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as they spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, they remain in the air at the end of your turn.

Airborne Form

name: Glyph Familiar
description:
You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures. You gain a familiar. You choose one familiar or master ability per day instead of two, but your familiar also always has three additional familiar abilities: construct, flier, and tough.

Enhanced Glyph Familiar

name: Gossamer Blade
description: Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of your weapon to resonate through its victim. The creature takes 1d6 persistent force damage per damage dice of your weapon.

name: Grasping Limbs
description: Your eidolon grabs enemies. Choose one of the eidolon’s unarmed attacks with the grapple trait. Your eidolon gains the Grab action on that unarmed attack.

name: Grave Focus
description: Studying necromancy in great depth has perfected your ability to find the links between life and death where you least expected. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

name: Greater Expanded Repertoire
description: You have gained extensive knowledge in the art of creating runes. Add two runes of 9th level or lower to your runic repertoire. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

name: Guiding Retort
description: With a cunning twist of their unarmed attack, your eidolon shifts the position of a foe. When your eidolon uses Eidolon’s Retort to Strike and hits, your eidolon can Reposition the target up to 10 feet.

name: Hallowed Earth
description: The earth is both where the dead rise from and where they are put to rest. Your presence sanctifies the earth around you. When an unholy creature ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes 2 spirit damage. If it’s an unholy undead creature, it takes an additional 2 vitality damage. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the spirit and vitality damage each increase by 2. Hallowed Earth lasts for 1 minute, but you can Dismiss it.

name: Hardened Chassis
description:
Your exterior is so tough that only the strongest of weapons can fully damage it. Choose one type of damage among bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. You gain resistance 3 to that type of damage. This resistance does not apply if the weapon or attack is adamantine.

Enhancement Your chassis gets even tougher. Choose one of the following benefits: you gain resistance 3 to all physical damage, or your chosen resistance increases to a value equal to half your level (minimum 3). This resistance is still bypassed by adamantine.

name: Harness Natural Magic
description: Although it’s often faint, you can sense the presence of magic all around you. Your internal nexus takes in that magic as easy as breathing. You become overflowing as if you have Absorbed Magic.

name: Hasted Assault
description: You can speed yourself up to move and attack more swiftly. You learn the hasted assault conflux spell.

name: Healing Nexus
description: You metabolize some of the magic you absorb into your internal nexus to stitch together any wounds on the rest of your body. You heal 30 Hit Points. At 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the amount of healing increases by 5. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Hedge Mage Dedication
description:
The Universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study. Grounding your theoretical studies in honest labor, you work with the mundane to draw forth their hidden magic. When you take this dedication, choose Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. You become trained in that skill, or you become expert if you were already trained. You also gain a keepsake that helps your magical studies; this keepsake is something that has perhaps been handed down to you but to which you’ve contributed a few personal touches, though it can be anything appropriate to your personal magical style. Sample keepsakes include a folio or binder of magical observations, a walking stick with mnemonic grooves, a bracelet of assorted charms and baubles, or a planchette carved into shape of a coffin. If it’s destroyed or lost, you can create a new keepsake with 1 day of downtime.

You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You’re trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for hedge mage archetype spells is your choice of Intelligence or Wisdom, and they are hedge mage spells of a tradition associated with the skill chosen for this dedication (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion).

Your keepsake holds 4 common cantrips of your choice from your appropriate tradition. You prepare spells each day by meditating with your keepsake. You can prepare two cantrips from your keepsake each day. You can only add cantrips to your keepsake with the Learn a Spell activity or by other similar means.

Basic Hedge Mage Spellcasting, Community Needs, Humble Spell, Keepsake of Power, Peer Past the Hedge, Practical Magic, Tender Ministrations

name: Heightened Captivation
description: You can infuse your charms and illusions with more power. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip spell granted by captivator archetype feats that’s at least 1 rank lower than your highest-rank non-cantrip captivator spells, that spell is heightened to the highest rank of captivator spell you can cast.

name: Henge Gate
description: You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them. The stones each appear in an unoccupied 5-foot space within 30 feet of you and within 15 feet of each other. When you raise the henge gate, choose one rune that can be drawn on a creature to carve into the stones. If you or an ally makes a successful ranged Strike using physical ammunition and that attack passes through the henge gate, the ammunition gains that rune in flight and automatically traces it on the target. The henge gate lasts for 1 minute.

name: Hobbling Criticals
description:
Your eidolon’s unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement. Whenever your eidolon gets a critical hit with one of their unarmed Strikes, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC after taking the damage. This is a critical specialization effect.

Critical Success The target takes no additional effect.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The target is slowed 1 and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is slowed 2 and takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

name: Hulking Size
description:
Your eidolon grows substantially. Your eidolon becomes Large, instead of their previous size, and their reach increases to 10 feet. This doesn’t change any of their other statistics.

Towering Size

name: Humble Spell
description: For basic spells, basic movements; you can do without flamboyant gestures or showy signs of power. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell, it loses the manipulate trait and gains the subtle trait. The trait hides only the spell’s spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects, so an observer might still see a ray streak out from you or see you vanish into thin air.

name: Hush
description:
You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help. You teleport to a square within 60 feet and make a Strike against a creature; if you hit, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is then immune to your Hush for 24 hours.

Success The target is otherwise unaffected.

Failure The target takes 10d6 force damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes 15d6 damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 minute.

name: Hybrid Study Spell
description: You gain the conflux spell from a hybrid study of your choice. If you don’t already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by studying your spellbook and performing a physical regimen. You don’t gain any of the hybrid study’s other benefits.

name: Incriminating Spell
description: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target’s mind. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the mental trait, choose a creature within 60 feet that the target can sense. The target will think that creature, instead of you, attempted to alter its mind when it succeeds at its save. If the target attempts to Sense Motive on either you or the incriminated creature, they must compare the results to your spell DC instead of the target’s Deception DC. If the incriminated creature is obviously incapable of using magic, the target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their perception check to Sense Motive.

name: Inevitable Thralls
description: You gain the necromancer's Inevitable Return reaction, allowing you to create thralls from the corpses of your enemies.

name: Infiltration Automation
description:
You have quiet, well-oiled joints, and you move around as silently as a shadow, though you sometimes use a magical boost. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks against hearing-based Perception checks. You can cast silence once per day on yourself as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell.

Enhancement You can cast silence twice per day on yourself, and you can choose whether to cast it as a 2nd- or 4th-rank spell.

name: Infused Void
description: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell. If this void damage or the spell reduces one or more creatures to 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 Focus Point. You can regain a Focus Point this way only once per 10 minutes.

name: Initial Eidolon Ability
description: Your link to your eidolon strengthens, granting them a new ability. Your eidolon gains the initial ability for an eidolon of their type.

name: Inscribed Blast
description:
Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes. The triggering creature or object takes 2d4 force damage and your inscribed runes fade. You re-inscribe your runes each day during your daily preparations.

At 10th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

Enhancement You can re-inscribe your runes with 10 minutes of work as an exploration activity.

name: Inspired Memory
description: A memory of each spell you have absorbed remains within your soul. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about creatures whose magic you have absorbed within the last minute. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Learn a Spell that you have absorbed within the last week.

name: Instant Army
description: You keep a reserve cache of thralls ready in case of an emergency. You create up to 20 thralls within 120 feet.

name: Instinctual Creation
description: You have trained to never be caught without some semblance of necromantic defense. You create two thralls in spaces adjacent to you.

name: Interstitial Escape
description: To evade your foe, you shift yourself to another location, teleporting from your current square to another unoccupied square within 30 feet. Additionally, you gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to 5 + your level.

name: Invert Harm
description: Your mastery of life and death grows. When you cast harm, it can heal living creatures as though they were undead.

name: Invisible Ink
description: After your rune is drawn, it flares once and then fades, leaving only the barest mark. When you apply a rune on an object or creature, you can Conceal an Object as a free action to hide that rune. If a creature would get a chance to find the rune, the GM uses your Crafting DC instead of your Stealth DC.

name: Keepsake of Power
prerequisites: Hedge Mage Dedication; Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion
description: Your keepsake might be disdained by your more orthodox peers as a crutch to your studies, but you know it grants you an understated, yet undeniable, power. Increase your limit on invested items from 10 to 12. If you have Incredible Investiture, instead increase your limit to 14. Investing worn magic items is explained here..

name: Killshot's Report
description: As you drop an enemy, a loud echo issues out as you chain the spell’s energy to a nearby creature. Choose a secondary target within 10 feet of the creature you reduced to 0 HP. This secondary target is affected by the spell you used for your Spellstrike. The creature gets any defense against the spell that Spellstrike normally allows, and you use your Strike result for a spell attack roll if needed. If the secondary target was already affected by the spell in some way (in the area of an Expansive Spellstrike, for example), it can’t be affected a second time.

name: Knockback Spell
description: You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, emanation, or line; has no duration; and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save, the spell unleashes a forceful blast that pushes creatures away, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its save against the spell is pushed 5 feet, and those who critically failed are pushed 10 feet. If the spell is a cone, emanation, or a line, you push the creature away from yourself. If the spell is a burst, you push the creature away from the center of the burst.

name: Knowledge is Power (Magus)
description:
When you critically succeed at a Recall Knowledge check about a creature, you can invoke your knowledge to make the creature take a –1 circumstance penalty to either AC and saves against the next attack you make against it, or the next spell you cast that it needs to defend against. The creature takes the same penalty to its attack or DC the next time it attacks against you or causes you to attempt a save against one of its effects.

If you share this information with your allies, they gain the benefits as well. If not used, the bonuses end after 1 minute.

name: Legendary Summoner
description: Your ability to summon extends past your other spellcasting. When you sacrifice a 9th-rank spell slot to gain two summoning slots using Master Summoner, you can use those slots to cast summon or incarnate spells heightened to 10th rank. You can’t use these spell slots for any purpose other than casting the summon or incarnate spells, and you don’t count as having 10th-rank spell slots for other abilities or rules.

name: Lifelink Surge
description: You can tap into your shared connection to heal your eidolon. You gain the lifelink surge link spell.

name: Link Focus
description: Communing with your eidolon helps you achieve a deeper focus. Whenever you Refocus, you completely refill your focus pool.

name: Living Graveyard
description: You conjure forth a massive, animated graveyard. You learn the living graveyard grave spell.

name: Living Lexicon
description: Your knowledge of runes knows no bounds. You add an additional rune to your runic repertoire of any level. Additionally, each day during your daily preparations, you can swap any one rune in your runic repertoire with another rune of the same level.

name: Living Nexus Dedication
prerequisites: trained in martial weapons; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
description:
Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you.

You have an invisible, internal nexus of energy and have learned how to control your absorption of others’ magical energy and store it in this internal nexus. You gain the Absorb Magic reaction and the Overflowing Blade action. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your nexus DC.

Absorb Magic [reaction] (concentrate, magical) Requirements You are not overflowing; Trigger Another creature within 30 feet Casts a Spell or uses an action, activity, or reaction with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait; Effect You breathe in a small fraction of the magic produced by the triggering effect, storing it in your internal nexus. You become overflowing. You remain overflowing for up to 1 minute before the stored magical energy fades. While overflowing, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, and primal traits. This bonus becomes +2 at 15th level.

Overflowing Blade [single action] (concentrate, force, magical) Requirements You are overflowing; Effect You conduct the magic in your internal nexus to coat your weapon or unarmed strike, empowering it with magical energy for a devastating attack. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits, you deal an additional 1d4 force damage. At 10th level, the additional damage increases to 2d4 force damage. At 18th level, the additional damage increases to 3d4 force damage. You are no longer overflowing.

Aether Beam, Aether Blast, Flexible Nexus, Harness Natural Magic, Healing Nexus, Inspired Memory, Null Field, Quick Absorption, Steal Magic's Breath, Surging Smash, The Taste of Magic

name: Look Again
description: If your charms or illusions fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again. If your next action is to cast an innate spell with either the illusion or mental trait and it fails to affect any targets, you do not lose the spell. You must use the same number of actions to recast the same spell on your following turn; if you can’t, or choose not to, you lose the spell. After this second casting, you lose the spell whether it affected any targets or not, and you can’t use Look Again until your next daily preparations. Look Again works only with spells that can affect creatures or require a target and doesn’t do anything if you cast the spell with no targets or creatures in the area.

name: Lunging Spellstrike
description: Your spell unwinds the structure of your staff to make it exceptionally long, or even separate it into shards held together by magical power. Make a Spellstrike with a staff, with a spell that isn’t a cantrip or focus spell. Increase the staff’s reach by 5 feet × the spell’s rank.

name: Magical Adept
description:
Your eidolon gains more magic. Choose one 2nd-rank spell and one 1st-rank spell of your eidolon’s tradition. Your eidolon can cast them each once per day as innate spells. At every even level after you take this feat, your eidolon can swap one of these innate spells for a new innate spell that’s 2 or more ranks lower than your highest-rank spell slot.

Magical Master

name: Magical Master
description: Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells. Choose an innate spell of your eidolon’s tradition of each of the spell ranks from 1 to 7 in which your eidolon doesn’t currently have an innate spell from Magical Adept. Your eidolon can cast each once per day as innate spells. You can swap these spells at every even level, but your eidolon can never know more than one spell of each spell rank 1 through 7.

name: Magical Onslaught
description: Your eidolon’s attack provides you an opening for one of your spells. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against a creature, and then you cast a 1- or 2-action cantrip targeting the same creature. If your eidolon’s Strike hits, the creature is off-guard against your spell (if it requires a spell attack roll) or takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save against your spell (if it requires a saving throw). If your eidolon’s Strike and the spell deal the same type of damage, combine the damage of both for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
