Both your eidolon’s attack and any spell attack roll you make count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both attacks have been made.

name: Magical Understudy
description:
Your eidolon evolves to cast spells. They gain the Cast a Spell activity and learn two cantrips of their tradition, which they can cast as innate spells.

Magical Adept, Share Eidolon Magic

name: Magus Dedication
description:
You cast spells like a magus, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your spellbook. You’re trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for magus archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are arcane magus spells. You become trained in Arcana; if you were already trained in Arcana, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Basic Magus Spellcasting, Basic Martial Magic, Hybrid Study Spell, Spellstriker

name: Magus's Analysis
description: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature, then recharge your Spellstrike. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if you previously hit the creature with a Strike this turn. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Magus’s Analysis for 1 day.

name: March of the Dead
description: You compel your horde of thralls, overwhelming your enemies. You command any number of thralls within 60 feet to Stride. After all their movement is complete, any enemy adjacent to three or more thralls must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become encumbered and slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Master Captivator Spellcasting
description: You master the most powerful spells that enchant and deceive. You learn a 7th-rank occult spell. At 18th level, you learn an 8th-rank spell, and at 20th level, you learn a 9th-rank spell. These spells must each have either the illusion or mental trait. You cast these spells as innate occult spells. You become a master in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics.

name: Master Hedge Mage Spellcasting
description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits. When you add spells to your keepsake from gaining a spell slot of a new rank from the hedge mage archetype, you can choose 3rd-rank spells. Your keepsake can also hold 3rd-rank spells.

name: Master Magus Spellcasting
prerequisites: Expert Magus Spellcasting; Legendary in Arcana
description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Master Necromancer Spellcasting
prerequisites: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting; Legendary in Occultism
description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Master Summoner
description:
During daily preparations, you can designate one of your spell slots to become two summoning slots of the same spell rank, from which you can cast only spells with the summon or incarnate trait.

Legendary Summoner

name: Master Summoner Spellcasting
prerequisites: Expert Summoner Spellcasting; legendary in the skill associated with your eidolon’s tradition
description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Maze of Runes
prerequisites: Legendary in Arcana, Legendary in Nature, Legendary in Occultism, or Legendary in Religion
description: You can trap a foe in a twisting, extradimensional labyrinth of ever-shifting runes. You can cast quandary once per day as an innate spell. The rank of this spell is equal to half your level rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least legendary in the related skill. Instead of the usual skill checks to solve the puzzle, the target of your quandary can attempt a Perception check, a Society check to Decipher Writing, or a check in the skill related to the tradition of the spell. When you Sustain this spell, you can also Trace a Rune or Invoke one Rune on the target creature as if it were adjacent to you.

name: Meld Into Eidolon
description:
Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon. You Manifest your Eidolon, but instead of summoning them into an adjacent open space, you become them. You can also Meld into Eidolon while your eidolon is manifested in an adjacent space. While Manifested in this way, you use your eidolon’s statistics, and you can’t act except to direct the eidolon to use Manifest an Eidolon to unmanifest themself. Your eidolon is affected by boost eidolon while Manifested in this way.

Since you can’t act, you can’t cast spells, activate or benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, perform actions that have the tandem trait, or use other abilities that require you, and not the eidolon, to act. You can’t be separately targeted while you are melded into the eidolon. When you reach 0 HP, your eidolon unmanifests, leaving your body behind, unconscious and dying.

name: Merciless Rend
description: Your eidolon rends their foes. They automatically deal the damage from their secondary attack to the enemy.

name: Messenger
description:
You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like. You gain message as an innate arcane cantrip.

Enhancement You can target up to five creatures at once when you cast message.

name: Meteoric Spellstrike
description: A trail of energy flows from your target back to you. Make a ranged Spellstrike against a target within your ranged weapon or unarmed attack’s first range increment. The spell you cast for the Spellstrike can’t be a cantrip or focus spell. Each creature in a line between you and the target (not including you and the target) takes damage equal to double the spell’s rank. The damage type is the same as that dealt by the spell you cast (choose one type if the spell dealt multiple types of damage).

name: Miniaturize
description: Your eidolon can shrink even further. When using Shrink Down, your eidolon can reduce their size to Tiny. When Tiny, their reach is 0 feet.

name: Mobile Thralls
description:
Your thralls can now follow you wherever you go. Any thrall you create has your choice of a climb Speed or swim Speed. The additional Speed is equal to its land Speed, and any time you let the thrall Stride, you can have it use the relevant movement action instead.

At 8th level, add a fly Speed to your choices. A flying thrall remains airborne at the end of your turn even if it didn’t Fly that turn.

name: Mortem Ultimatum
description: You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

name: Muscle Barrier
description: You create an extra thick layer of muscle to protect your target. You learn the muscle barrier grave spell.

name: Nature's Embrace
description: You call on the world to hamper your foes. Plants grab at them, wind or water currents buffet them, the footing shifts under their feet. Your waking world becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until the start of your next turn.

name: Necromancer Dedication
description:
You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your dirge. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for necromancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are occult necromancer spells. You become trained in Occultism; if you were already trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Once per turn you can use a single action to create a single thrall within 30 feet. This action has the concentrate, manipulate, necromancer, occult, and thrall traits. You can use the Command a Thrall action as described in the thrall trait.

Basic Death Dealing, Basic Necromancer Spellcasting, Inevitable Thralls, Necrotic Bomber, Thrall Charger

name: Necromantic Lifesense
description:
Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to sense the life force of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

Additionally, you know the current Hit Points and temporary Hit Points of any living or undead creature you can see within 30 feet.

name: Necrotic Bomber
description: You gain the necrotic bomb grave spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by spending 10 minutes doing the necromancer's Refocus options.

name: Nimble Form
description: Your eidolon evolves into a figure of pure grace. Your multiple attack penalty from your eidolon’s agile unarmed attacks becomes –3 for a second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8).

name: Null Field
description: You understand the frequency of energies that have damaged you and can extend the magical network of power in your internal nexus to diffuse incoming attacks. Choose one type of energy damage you have taken within the last minute. You gain resistance to that energy type equal to half your level for 1 minute.

name: Ocular Flesh
description:
You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble. You can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to look through any of your eyeballs until the start of your next turn. An eyeball can be manipulated like a marble, such as being rolled or thrown. One can also be affixed to a surface, for example a wall, with 1 minute’s work. An eyeball lasts for 24 hours, and you can maintain a total of three eyeballs at any given time. Creating a fourth destroys the oldest eyeball.

Eyeballs are very small but are easy to spot. A creature actively Seeking or Searching automatically finds an eyeball. They’re also not very sturdy and can be destroyed with an Interact action.

name: Orbiting Runestone
description:
You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object. The runestone has 10 Hit Points. Each time a creature successfully Strikes you, attempt a DC 11 flat check. On a success, the runestone blocks the attack, so the attack first damages the runestone and then applies any remaining damage to you. If this damage reduces the runestone to 0 Hit Points, it explodes outward toward the attacker. If the attacker is within 15 feet, the rune etched upon the runestone invokes automatically, applying its invocation effect to the attacker. The attacker is the only one affected by the invocation, even if the rune could normally affect multiple creatures.

The runestone’s magic is capable of maintaining the traced rune for up to 1 minute as it floats around you, at which point the rune fades and the runestone shatters. You can maintain only a single orbiting rune at any given time. If you try to create a second, the first one shatters.

name: Ostentatious Arrival
description: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the creature you summoned or manifested except you take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank for a summon or incarnate spell, or 1d4 fire damage per 2 levels for Manifesting your Eidolon. If the creature you summoned or manifested has the acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or water trait, the damage is that type instead (or bludgeoning damage for the water trait). If the creature has more than one of these traits, you choose which damage type to deal.

name: Osteo Armaments
description:
If you have bones, you have a weapon. You create a +1 striking weapon in which you are proficient, made of bone and sinew. If this weapon requires ammunition, mundane bone ammunition is created when you reload it. The weapon falls apart and is destroyed after 1 hour, if you aren’t holding the weapon at the end of your turn, or if you use this action again, whichever comes first.

At 8th level, you can destroy an adjacent thrall as part of using this action. If you do, the action gains the thrall trait and the weapon also gains a decaying rune, or the greater decaying rune if you’re 15th level or higher.

At 10th level, the weapon improves to a +2 striking weapon, increasing to a +2 greater striking weapon at 12th level, a +3 greater striking weapon at 16th level, or a +3 major striking weapon at 19th level.

name: Overburdening Spell
description: You have learned how to weigh down your enemies’ life essence. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that targets a single creature, unless the target is unaffected by the spell, the target takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round (this penalty is doubled for climb, fly, and swim Speeds).

name: Overburn
description:
You engage your core, giving yourself more energy and speed for a fight. You gain haste as an innate arcane 3rd-rank spell that you can cast once per day. You can target only yourself with this spell.

Enhancement You instead can cast haste as a 7th-rank innate arcane spell once per day. You must be one of the targets of the spell.

name: Overloaded Ammunition
description:
You can tenuously bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles. During your daily preparations, you can lay power-containing runes upon two pieces of mundane ammunition to transform them into explosive ammunition. The DC of the explosive ammunition is equal to your class DC. The binding on the powder is unstable, and the ammunition burns itself to ash by your next daily preparations if not used. This ammunition has no value if sold.

At 14th level, you create greater explosive ammunition instead.

name: Overwhelming Harm
description: Your ability to manipulate void energy has led you to the conclusion that more is always better. Whenever you cast the 3-action version of harm, you can extend the area to a 60-foot emanation.

name: Overwhelming Spellstrike
description: You pierce through your foe’s resistance. Make a Spellstrike. The spell you cast as part of the Spellstrike ignores an amount of the target’s resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. A creature’s immunities are unaffected.

name: Pattern Flight
description: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it. Make a ranged Strike against a target within your weapon’s first range increment. Because of the erratic nature of its flight, this Strike ignores any circumstance bonus to AC from cover. After your Strike, you can Trace a Rune on one target in a straight line between you and the target of your Strike (including the original target).

name: Peer Past the Hedge
description: You can pick up on subtle magic with ease. Add the detect magic cantrip to your keepsake. Additionally, you can perform the Detect Magic exploration activity at the same time as the Search exploration activity.

name: Perfected Thrall
description: Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall. You learn the perfected thrall grave spell.

name: Phase Out
description: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force, spirit, and vitality) equal to half your level. They’re not incorporeal, but can’t use Strikes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip. Your eidolon can Dismiss this effect to return to their normal form.

name: Piercing Jab
description: Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike with their primary attack. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is grabbed by your eidolon until it successfully Escapes, your eidolon attacks with their primary attack again, or your eidolon is no longer manifested, whichever comes first. When the target is no longer grabbed, it takes persistent bleed damage equal to the primary attack’s number of weapon damage dice.

name: Poison Drinker
description: You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest. You regain Hit Points equal to the level of the poison (or double the spell’s rank if the poison was caused by a spell), and you gain as much nourishment as one square meal.

name: Power Hungry
description: You focus your hunger, allowing you to consume even more power from your thralls. Whenever you destroy three thralls with Reclaim Power, you completely refill your focus pool.

name: Powerful Tail
description:
You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This tail is in the brawling group.

Enhancement Your tail is not only powerful but also flexible. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet, and you reduce the number of free hands required to Climb or Trip by one.

name: Practical Magic
description:
Want not, waste not; through a mix of frugality, inspiration, and sheer resourcefulness, you maintain a catalog of materials with ambient, lingering magic, which you can transform into temporary spell catalysts. Be it powder ground from the burnt remains of hippogriff feathers or yarn drawn from the locks of an alicorn, you have these materials at hand and, perhaps more importantly, know how to bend them toward practical effects. These consumable items can change or enhance the effects of specific spells. To get the most out of a spell catalyst, you or an ally should be able to cast the affected spell.

You know the formulas for all common spell catalysts of your level or lower. You remember spell catalyst formulas and don’t need a formula book for them. Each day during your daily preparations, you can make two spell catalysts with an item level no higher than half your level. You must know each spell catalyst’s formula. A spell catalyst created this way is a temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven’t already used it.

name: Preternatural Parry
description: You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the triggering effect until the start of your next turn.

name: Prodigal Rune-Singer
description:
You have mastered the art of singing your runes. You can Trace a Rune with song once per round instead of once per 10 minutes.

Generational Rune-Singer

name: Protective Bond
description:
The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm. If you and your eidolon would take different amounts of damage from the area effect, you take the lower amount of damage instead of the greater amount of damage.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

name: Purge System
description:
You can sense the influence of harmful toxins in your body, and you heat and cool various parts of your body to expel them. Choose one poison that is affecting you. Reduce the stage of that poison by one.

Enhancement When you use Purge System, you instead reduce the stage of the poison by two.

name: Quick Absorption
description: After so much exposure to the myriad forms of magical energy, you absorb magic almost instinctively. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that can only be used to Absorb Magic.

name: Raise a Tome
description:
You can flip open a book to simultaneously study and deflect attacks. When you Raise a Shield, you can raise a book you’re wielding instead of a shield. While you have a book raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks to identify creatures using a skill related to the subject of the book (Arcana if you’re using your spellbook). If consulting the book normally grants an item bonus to the check for consulting the book, you gain this bonus as well.

If you have Shield Block, you can use a raised tome for that feat as though it were a shield. The tome has Hardness 3, HP 12, and BT 6.

In addition, you can inscribe the reinforcing rune into your spellbook to strengthen your tomes, using the same process as transferring a rune. The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. The rune’s benefits apply to any one tome in your possession chosen during your daily preparations. If your spellbook leaves your possession, the rune-granting benefit is suppressed until you get the book back.

Shielded Tome

name: Ranged Combatant
description: Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance. Your eidolon gains a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the magical and propulsive traits. When you select this feat, choose a damage type for the attack: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, spirit, vitality, or void.

name: Rapid Manifestation
description: Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you’re in danger. You Manifest your Soulforged Armament.

name: Rapid Recharge
description: You tap into an arcane trick to recover your ability to meld spells and attacks. You recharge your Spellstrike.

name: Reach of the Dead
description: You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has range, you cast that spell from one of your thralls within 60 feet. That thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell; calculate range and cover from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

name: Reactive Charm
description: You’re so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple charm in time to foil an attacker. You can cast one of your innate 1st-rank spells with the mental trait that normally takes two actions or fewer to cast as a reaction. This takes effect before the triggering spell or attack, and if the attacker is affected by your spell, it can make different decisions for its attack or spell (for instance, if you charm the attacker, it can choose a different target than you for its attack or spell). The attacking creature must be in range of your chosen spell, and if your spell requires targets, the attacking creature must be a valid target. Your spell affects only the attacking creature, even if it would normally affect more targets or an area.

name: Reactive Dismissal
description: You abruptly dismiss your eidolon to reduce the damage they take, though this makes summoning them again more difficult. Reduce the triggering damage to your eidolon by double your level, and your eidolon unmanifests. You can’t Manifest your Eidolon again until after the end of your next turn.

name: Reactive Spellshift
description: You can reflexively shift a spell even as it’s being cast. You attempt to Shift the triggering Spell even if you do not meet the other requirements to Shift Spell. On a success, the spellshift applies to the spell’s effects as appropriate for the chosen spellshift. After you choose your spellshift, but before you attempt your Arcana check, the caster can voluntarily let their spell be disrupted. Regardless of the outcome, the caster then becomes immune to your Reactive Spellshift for 10 minutes.

name: Reanimate Foe
description: You attempt to bring a creature back to life to fight by your side. You learn the reanimate foe grave spell.

name: Recharging Flurry
description: The clash of steel fuels your magic, preparing you to unleash another magic-infused assault. Make one Strike with each of your weapons, then recharge your Spellstrike (regardless of whether the Strikes hit). Your multiple attack penalty increases after each Strike as normal. If the second Strike targets a creature you haven’t attacked yet this turn, its multiple attack penalty is –4 if it’s your second attack this turn (–3 if you’re using an agile weapon) or –8 if it’s your third or further Strike (–6 with an agile weapon).

name: Reclaim Power
description:
You use your thralls to restore yourself. Destroy up to three of your thralls within 60 feet and regain Hit Points equal to your level per thrall destroyed. If you destroy three thralls total, you can also decrease one of your clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, or stupefied condition values by 1.

Power Hungry

name: Recurring Nightmare
description: You summon a lingering spirit that just won’t stay dead. You learn the recurring nightmare grave spell.

name: Redirect Spell
description:
You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another. You gain the Redirect Magic spellshift.

Spellshift—Redirect Magic Through sheer force of will, you can direct a spell’s energies away from its caster’s intended target.

Critical Success You change a single target of the spell to another viable target within 30 feet of you (even if it would be outside of the spell’s normal range). You can’t use this spellshift to affect a creature twice with the same spell. If the spell had an initial saving throw, the new target must attempt it, possibly achieving a different result than the original target of the spell. The DC for the spell becomes your Arcana DC instead of the original caster’s spell DC.

Success As critical success, but if the target succeeds at any required saving throw, they are unaffected, and the spell does not change targets.

name: Redirect Teleportation
description: You’re able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears. You expend a prepared spell that has the teleportation trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell. The counteract rank for this effect is equal to the rank of the expended spell. If you succeed on your counteract check, you don’t disrupt the spell. Instead, you choose an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you for the creature to teleport into. You can’t choose a space that is obviously harmful (such as into a wall of fire or hazardous terrain) or would cause the target to fall.

name: Reinforce Eidolon
description: You buffer your eidolon. You gain the reinforce eidolon link cantrip.

name: Reinforced Skeleton
description: You take on the toughness and lightness of bone. You gain resistance equal to half your level to two damage types; one is your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and the other is your choice of slashing or piercing. You also gain a +5- foot status bonus to your Speeds. Whenever you destroy a thrall, this bonus to your Speeds increases to +10 feet for 1 round.

name: Remote Detonation
description: You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice. Make a ranged Strike that uses physical ammunition against a target within the first range increment of your weapon. If it hits, you Invoke Runes on the target as whisper of the ammunition’s flight sets off the runes. You can invoke up to two runes this way, but all the runes must be on the target of your Strike. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on any saving throws against the runes invoked by your Remote Detonation.

name: Resilient Chassis
description:
You are tough enough to draw on your own internal stores of energy when you get injured. You gain 4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the temporary Hit Points increase by 4.

Enhancement Resilient Chassis’s frequency becomes once per 10 minutes.

name: Resilient Shell
description: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks. They gain resistance 5 to physical damage. At 17th level, the resistance increases to 6.

name: Resounding Cascade
description: The magical reinforcement from your Arcane Cascade extends to nearby allies. While you’re in Arcane Cascade stance, you grant its extra damage and resistance in an aura affecting all allies in a 5-foot emanation. This uses only the base values of your stance; it doesn’t use any increase you get from bonuses, the laughing shadow hybrid study, or the like. As normal for duplicate effects, multiple Arcane Cascades affecting the same creature aren’t cumulative.

name: Return Unto Runes
description:
You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the spell becomes sealed in a rune, which floats around you. Until the end of your next turn, you can Trace this Rune onto a creature as normal. This rune doesn’t have an effect until it’s invoked.

When the rune is invoked, the rune-bearer is affected by the spell or magical attack captured in the rune. Make a check, using your class DC – 10 as the modifier against the rune‑bearer’s AC to determine the effects.

name: Rune Ward
description: You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw and AC against the spell.

name: Rune-Singer
description:
You practice the lost art of using music to guide your runecarving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them. You can use Performance instead of Crafting when attempting Crafting checks related to runes.

Once per 10 minutes, you can Trace a Rune with song alone. When you do, you use the 2-action version of Trace Rune as a single action without needing an artisan's toolkit, and you remove the action's manipulate trait. You don't need to be able to move your hands when Tracing a Rune using song, but you do need to be able to sing in a clear voice.

Prodigal Rune-Singer, Song of Glorious Invocation

name: Runesight
description: It is impossible for those bearing runes to hide from you. You can sense the presence of all rune-bearers within 60 feet as a precise sense.

name: Runesmith Dedication
description:
You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

You can etch runes. An etched rune is carved, inked, or branded; this application does not damage the creature or item. Etching a rune requires an artisan's toolkit. Your magic can sustain up to one etched rune at a time. If you're at least 9th level, increase the maximum number of etched runes you can sustain at a time to 2, and if you're at least 17th level, increase it to 3. You can etch any number of runes up to your maximum during your daily preparations or by spending 10 minutes in exploration mode. Your etched runes remain indefinitely until they're expended or removed or until you etch more runes than your maximum, which causes your oldest rune to fade. Additionally, you gain the Solitary Invocation action.

Solitary Invocation [single action] (invocation, magical, runesmith) You utter the name of one of your runes within 30 feet, which blazes with power, applying the effect in its Invocation entry. An invoked rune then fades away, its task complete.

Basic Rune Magic, Expanded Repertoire, Greater Expanded Repertoire, Tracing Studies

name: Runic Correspondence
prerequisites: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion
description:
You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought. Once per day, you can take 1 minute to write a message of 25 words or fewer anywhere that can, at least momentarily, hold writing (such as on a piece of parchment, drawn in the sand, or lightly scratched onto soft metal). When you are finished, mentally picture one creature you know well. If the target creature is on the same plane as you, your message appears in their line of sight on any surface that can hold writing. It can be seen by only the target, and the target can read the message even if you don’t share a language. The message disappears once the target reads it, but the creature can respond by spending 1 minute to write their own message of 25 words or fewer in the same way. You instantly receive that message when it is finished, and you can read it even if you don’t share a language.

If you spend 10 minutes writing your message instead, you can include a rune from your runic repertoire. If the target is willing, after reading your message, you Trace the Rune on the target to last for up to 10 minutes. When you receive the creature’s reply, you can Invoke that Rune as a free action.

name: Runic Expertise
description: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.

name: Runic Impression
description: You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks. You learn the runic impression conflux spell.

name: Runic Reprisal
description: When you Raise your Shield, you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon. When you use Fortifying Knock, you can Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on your shield, even if it normally couldn’t be applied to a shield. The traced rune doesn’t have its normal effect, instead fading into your shield. If you Shield Block with the shield against a melee Strike, you can Invoke the Rune as part of the reaction, causing the rune to detonate outward and apply its invocation effect to the attacking creature.

name: Runic Tattoo
description:
By drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you’ll never be without it. Choose one rune you know, which you apply as a tattoo to your body. The rune is always etched on your body and does not count toward your maximum limit of etched runes. You can invoke this rune like any of your other runes, but once invoked, the rune fades significantly and is drained of power until your next daily preparations.

You can magically alter your runic tattoo to change it to another rune you know (or remove it altogether) with 1 day of downtime.

Words, Fly Free

name: Running Recharge
description: Preparing in every way for your next assault, you both relocate yourself and ready your Spellstrike. You recharge your Spellstrike and either Stride up to half your Speed or Step.

name: Sanguine Mastery
description:
Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand against you. You gain resistance to bleed damage equal to half your level. Additionally, if an enemy within 30 feet of you is bleeding, you gain fast healing equal to half your level. This fast healing is deactivated while you have the dying condition.

In addition, whenever you destroy a thrall, a creature adjacent to the thrall takes 1 persistent bleed damage. If that creature is already taking bleed damage, instead increase its bleed damage by 1. A creature can have its bleed damage increased in this way only once per round.

name: Sanguine Transference
description: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall. You learn the sanguine transference grave spell.

name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
description:
You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps. Even if you aren’t Searching, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. As long as you are holding or wearing an artisan’s toolkit, you can use Crafting instead of Thievery to disable a magical trap, treating your proficiency in Crafting as your proficiency in Thievery for requirements.

In addition, if you trigger a trap by critically failing a check to Disable it, you can Trace a Rune on yourself as a reaction, gaining the benefits of the rune before the trap affects you.

name: Shades of Meaning
description: As the gap between your intention and your words becomes almost nothing, you find that you don't need to consciously draw the diacritic marks that would embellish or modify your runes. As you draw a rune, it continues to grow outward like a living thing, applying the exact accent or stress mark you intended for it to have. Whenever you etch or Trace a Rune, you can choose to also apply one diacritic rune you know to it as part of the same action.

name: Share Eidolon Magic
description: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you. You can cast the innate spells your eidolon gained from Magical Understudy, Magical Adept, and Magical Master. You and your eidolon share the same daily uses of these innate spells.

name: Shared Focus
description: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point. Choose a willing ally within 30 feet who also has a focus pool. The target gains 1 temporary Focus Point until the start of your next turn, at which time it’s lost, even if not spent. This temporary Focus Point is separate from the Focus Points in their focus pool, allowing them to have it even if they’re at their pool’s maximum. The creature then becomes temporarily immune to Shared Focus until their next daily preparations.

name: Sheltering Hand
description: Animals, plants, and the earth itself rush to protect you from harm, interposing themselves between you and danger. You and your allies in your waking world gain cover from enemies you are aware of until the start of your next turn. The cover is based on the number of actions you spend. If you use one action, it is lesser cover; if you spend two actions, it is standard cover.

name: Shielded Tome
description: You can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait. The shield appears in the book as an elaborate bookmark. The fusion lasts until you fuse a shield into a new book or the book is out of your possession for 24 hours. While the two are fused, the book shares the Hardness, Hit Points, and Broken Threshold of the shield. The fused item has the shield’s activations and benefits (such as a spellguard shield’s bonus to saving throws against magic), and it can still be consulted as normal for purposes like Recall Knowledge and the benefits of Raise a Tome. If the shield or your spellbook is etched with a reinforcing rune, the fused item gains the rune while they’re fused; if both have the rune, the highest-level rune applies.

name: Shrink Down
description:
Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces. Your eidolon reduces to a smaller size of your choosing, to a minimum of size Small. They can Dismiss this action to return to their normal size. Their reach becomes 5 feet, or 10 feet if shrinking to Large with Towering Size.

Miniaturize

name: Shrink Spell
description: You’ve learned to manipulate space to narrow the impact of other spells. When you use Counterspell to attempt to counteract a spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, you reduce the area of the spell if you fail to counteract it. Remove 5 feet from the radius of a burst or emanation or 10 feet from the length of a cone or line.

name: Simple Mastery
description: Other casters’ never-ending hunger for new magic prevents them from truly understanding just how far simple magic can be pushed when truly mastered. If your next action is to Cast a spell you prepared from your keepsake, you Cast the Spell as though it is 1 rank higher, up to the highest rank spell you can cast.

name: Skeletal Extension
description: You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths. If the next action you take is to cast a grave spell that destroys a thrall, pieces of the thrall fuse with you to extend the length of your limbs. Until the end of the turn, your reach increases by 10 feet, and you can move 15 feet whenever you Step.

name: Skeletal Lancers
description: You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors. You learn the skeletal lancers grave spell.

name: Skilled Partner
description: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat. At 7th level, your eidolon gains an additional skill feat of 7th level or lower.

name: Smithing Weapons
description: Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies. While wielding a weapon in the hammer, knife, and pick weapon group, you can use that weapon to etch runes without an artisan's toolkit. Additionally, a Strike with a hammer, knife, or pick deals 1 additional fire damage to an enemy bearing one of your runes as sparks fly on impact like a hammer to an anvil.

name: Song of Glorious Invocation
description: You weave the true names of several runes you’ve drawn into a beautiful song, invoking them all simultaneously. Choose up to three rune-bearers within 30 feet and Invoke one Rune on each of them. The song also inspires the rune-bearers, granting them a +1 status bonus to skill checks and saves against fear effects for 1 minute.

name: Song of the Soul
description: You transform a thrall into a special instrument that plays a silent, soothing song heard only by a creature’s soul. You learn the song of the soul grave spell.

name: Soul Arsenal
description:
Choose an additional soulforged armament of a different type than you already chose, and choose one essence power for it. Upgrade or change your armaments individually.

When you Manifest Soulforged Armament, you can summon any number of your armaments (you must meet the requirements for each), and when you Dismiss the effect, you can choose to Dismiss some and not others. You can choose to manifest the essence form of any number of your armaments when you take the action. Each armament can manifest its essence form only once per day.

When you gain soulforged corruption, you choose one armament’s corruption flaw to affect you for stage 1. At stage 2, you take the flaws of all your soulforged armaments. While you have the curse, each armament gets a separate flat check if you try to manifest its essence form, and failing the check prevents you from manifesting only that armament’s essence form.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 12th level, choosing the final item type.

name: Soul Flare
description: You strive to change the outcome with sheer zeal. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll if making an attack or to your AC if you were hit. This can change the outcome of the roll. If this bonus turns your missed attack into a hit or the hit against you into a miss, attempt a DC 5 flat check. If you fail, your soulforged armament is Dismissed—your weapon if you attacked or your armor or shield if you were defending.

name: Soul Thief
description:
You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute. Attempt an Occultism check against the hard DC of the target’s level. On a success, you capture its soul and solidify it into a gem that keeps the soul contained. While the soul is contained, it can’t be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as the wish ritual. If a gem is destroyed, the soul is freed, and you become alerted to its destruction. You can maintain only three gems at any given time. If you attempt to make a fourth, you must choose a soul to be released.

You can consume a captured soul by swallowing a gem. Doing so grants you the unholy and undead traits and extends your existence by 50 years. You gain void healing, you aren’t instantly destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points, and you can’t be instantly killed by death effects. If you’re destroyed, you can rebuild yourself in the location of one of your soul gems. This consumes the gem, and it takes 24 hours for your body to be rebuilt. If you are ever destroyed and are unable to rebuild your body, all souls that you have consumed are released.

name: Soulforger Dedication
prerequisites: Wisdom +2 or ability to cast divine spells
description:
You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You bind a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as a soulforged armament. Choose a motivation or cause known as a soul path (page 101) that ties you to your soulforged armament; acting against or ignoring your soul path is anathema to you and could lead you to be afflicted with a curse called soulforged corruption. Choose one essence power for the armament (see archetype). Changing an essence power requires 1 week of retraining, and you can’t retrain them while you have soulforged corruption.

You can Manifest Soulforged Armament to summon your soulforged armaments in combat.

Manifest Soulforged Armament [single action] (concentrate, divine, extradimensional) Requirements If summoning a soulforged weapon or shield, you have the hands free to wield it; if summoning soulforged armor, you aren’t wearing any armor; Effect You immediately wield or wear the soulforged armament bound to you. The soulforged armament remains manifested until you Dismiss this effect.

Once per day when you use this ability, you can manifest the armament’s essence form. You gain the armament’s essence power until it’s Dismissed. After 1 minute, the essence form armament is automatically Dismissed.

Devastating Manifestation, Rapid Manifestation, Soul Arsenal, Soul Flare

name: Spatial Awareness
description:
Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to counteract a teleportation effect.

When a teleportation effect occurs within 60 feet of you, you detect the location of the effect as a precise sense. If the effect is a creature teleporting away from that space, you know the general direction of the location to which it teleported but not the distance. However, you can attempt to Identify Magic within an hour of the teleportation to know the location to which the creature teleported within 10 miles on a success or 1 mile on a critical success.

name: Speak with Days Long Dead
description:
You channel the essences and echoes of spirits long dead that reside within a location, an object, or a bloodline. You spend 10 minutes and must be within the location, be able to touch a piece of the object, or drink a drop of blood of the bloodline as appropriate to the spirits you wish to channel. You learn one piece of information or about one significant event relating directly to the location, object, or bloodline that has occurred within the last year. You can channel any given target only once every 24 hours.

At 12th level, you can learn about information or events that took place within the last decade, within the last century if you are 16th level, or at any point in history at 20th level.

name: Spell Crash
prerequisites: Your Spellstrike is charged, and you have at least one spell prepared in a spell slot
description:
Instead of blending a spell into an attack, you can funnel the spell’s magic into a pure blast that expands out from you. You smash your weapon or fist into the ground and expend a spell prepared in one of your spell slots. The magic of the spell explodes out in your choice of a 20-foot emanation, 30-foot cone, or 60-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 1d10 force damage per spell rank of the expended spell, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. If your weapon has the shove trait, you push any creature that fails its save 10 feet; if your weapon has the trip trait, any creature that fails its save falls prone. Your Spellstrike is no longer charged.

If the spell you expended could deal a type of damage other than force, you can change the explosion’s damage to that type and replace Spell Crash’s force trait with the corresponding trait.

name: Spell Parry
description:
You infuse magical power into your body or armaments to parry both physical and magical assaults. You raise your guard, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn, as long as you continue to meet the requirements.

Preternatural Parry

name: Spell Retaliation
description: Battling other spellcasters is one of your major focuses, and harnessing magic from spells you defend against gives you everything you need to fight back. You recharge your Spellstrike.

name: Spell Swipe
description:
You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit. Make a Spellstrike, but roll separate Strikes to attack two creatures, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other. If your spell could affect two or more targets or would normally have an area, your spell affects whichever foes you hit, not just the first target; otherwise, choose one target to affect with the spell. As Spellstrike, Spell Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you make both attacks.

If you’re using a weapon that has the sweep trait, its circumstance bonus applies against both targets. You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the two targets to determine the area.

name: Spell-Repelling Form
description: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger of spells. They gain a +1 status bonus to all saving throws against magic.

name: Spellbinding Speech
description: All the time you’ve spent discussing esoteric theses and performing spell incantations has made your words magical even when you aren’t casting a full spell. Choose a creature within 30 feet who can hear and understand you, and attempt an Arcana check against their Will DC. On a success, your seemingly mundane speech is laced with spellbinding magic, preventing your target from using reactions until the start of your next turn. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to your Spellbinding Speech for 24 hours.

name: Spellshifter Dedication
description:
You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects. You accomplish this through the use of a spellshifting conduit, a magical object of your choice that has light Bulk and can be held in one hand. If your conduit is lost or destroyed, you can train yourself to use a new one by spending 10 minutes attuning yourself to it. You gain the Shift Spell action and the Share the Burden spellshift.

Shift Spell [single action] (concentrate, manipulate) Requirements You are within the affected area of an ongoing spell, or you can physically touch an object or creature under the effects of a spell, and you are holding your conduit; Effect Choose a spellshift and attempt an Arcana check against the DC of the spell (or the spell DC of the spellcaster if the spell does not normally have a DC). The caster immediately becomes aware that you’re trying to shift their spell and intuitively knows the potential effects of the shift, but not the result of your skill check. A willing caster can allow you to achieve one degree of success higher than the result of your check. The effects of the check are dependent on the chosen spellshift. Regardless of the result, the spell becomes immune to Shift Spell for 24 hours.

Spellshift—Shift Burden You share the burden of a spell, allowing you to share control with the caster. If Sustaining a spell with this spellshift causes a creature to attempt a saving throw, it is attempted against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, make the attack using your Arcana modifier instead of the spell’s normal spell attack modifier.

Critical Success If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell. For the remainder of the spell’s duration, you can Sustain the spell as though you were the caster.

Success If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell.

Analyze Magic, Dismantle Spell, Elemental Subsitution, Enhance Spell, Reactive Spellshift, Redirect Spell, Subtle Shift

name: Spellstriker
description: You gain the magus’s Spellstrike activity. You can recharge it only as an activity that takes 1 minute. This restriction applies even if you gain another ability that normally recharges Spellstrike.

name: Spirit Sheath
description:
You’ve magically constructed an extradimensional sheath for your weapon that you access through your clothing, typically through a pocket, sleeve, or seam. This sheath is hard to notice, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to Conceal an Item within it. A spirit sheath can hold up to 1 Bulk worth of weapons.

During a Spellstrike, you can Interact to draw one weapon from the sheath before you Cast the Spell. You can draw or return a weapon to a spirit sheath as an Interact action, as can anyone else holding or wearing the clothing that contains the sheath. A dispel magic spell or similar effect can be used against the spirit sheath to expel the weapon. The counteract check is made against your spell DC and the counteract rank is half your level rounded up. The weapon is also expelled if you become unconscious.

name: Split Spellstrike
description: Like knives slicing through magic itself, both your weapons carry your spell, delivering it to separate foes. Make a Spellstrike with a spell that can target at least 2 creatures or that has an area. You can make two melee Strikes instead of one, but each must be made with a different weapon and target a different creature. Increase your multiple attack penalty normally after each Strike rather than increasing it for Spellstrike as a whole. If you’re in Arcane Cascade, you can apply twofold tine’s extra benefit between the two Strikes.

name: Sprinting Spellstrike
description:
Magic propels you across the battlefield as you speed toward your target. Make a Spellstrike, casting a spell that has a line area. Before making your Strike, you Stride in a straight line to a distance up to the line’s length; you can move through enemies during this movement, and your movement doesn’t trigger reactions. You can use Sprinting Spellstrike while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

Special If you have the Expansive Spellstrike feat, the spell’s area uses the line of your movement instead of the normal method of determining the line.

name: Standby Spell
description: You’ve honed one spell as your favored combat technique, and you’ve practiced it enough that you no longer need to prepare it to cast it. Choose a spell in your spellbook that you could use with Spellstrike and that has a rank no higher than the highest-rank magus spell slot you have. You can cast this spell without having it prepared ahead of time by expending a spell slot of a sufficient rank to cast your chosen spell. You can change this spell whenever you add new spells to your spellbook, or by studying your spellbook for 1 hour.

name: Starlit Eyes
description:
Starlight shines in your sight, enhancing your perception and range. When you make a ranged Strike, you lower the DC of your flat check to target a creature that’s concealed or hidden from you. The DC is reduced to 4 instead of 5 against a concealed creature and to 10 instead of 11 against a hidden one. If you’re in Arcane Cascade stance, you instead reduce the DC to 3 against a concealed creature or 9 against a hidden one.

In addition, when you cast shooting star and target a hidden creature, you don’t have to attempt the flat check for targeting a hidden creature with a ranged Strike.

name: Steal Magic's Breath
description:
Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely. You become overflowing as if you had Absorbed Magic. Additionally, you reduce the amount of damage the triggering spell or ability deals by 6d6 for all creatures targeted by the spell or ability. This reduction is applied before any weaknesses or resistances are taken into account. If you completely mitigate the damage to a creature, the triggering spell or ability has no effect on them.

The amount of damage reduced increases by 1d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

name: Steed Form
description:
Your eidolon changes to make them particularly effective as your mount. While you ride them, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does (see the Riding Sapient Creatures sidebar). Your eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride them. Since you work together to move, your eidolon’s move actions while you’re mounted gain the tandem trait.

Riding along on a sapient creature that isn’t a minion requires a lot of coordination and timing. Both the riding creature and the mount regain only 2 actions at the start of their turns each round, as both the mount and the riding creature interfere with one another’s actions. If you ride your eidolon, you reduce your total actions to 2 and continue to share actions normally—you don’t reduce the number of actions twice.

name: Stolen Spell
description: As you perfectly counter a spell, you re-aim its magic to use it yourself. You gain the ability to cast the triggering spell one time before the end of your next turn, even if it’s not on your spell list or is of a higher rank than you can cast. This doesn’t cost you a spell slot or other resource. If you cast it as part of a Spellstrike against the creature that originally cast it, that creature is off-guard against your Strike. Use your own spellcasting statistics for this spell, as you do for other spells you cast.

name: Stone Forge of the First
description: You conjure forth a massive stone forge within 30 feet that occupies a 15-foot cube in empty spaces on the ground. The forge lasts for 1 minute before crumbling into dust. The forge amplifies the power of runes in a 60-foot emanation. The duration of a traced rune doesn’t elapse while it’s within the emanation but resumes once the rune is outside the emanation. Additionally, runes invoked within the forge’s emanation don’t fade, but instead become faint. Faint runes maintain their passive benefits but can’t be invoked again.

name: Striker's Scroll
description:
You can attach a scroll to your weapon or handwraps of mighty blows to blend its spell into an attack, carefully folding it around a part of the weapon or sealing it to the weapon’s surface. Attaching a scroll requires using the Affix a Talisman action. You can have only one scroll affixed to a weapon at a time, and you can’t have both a talisman and scroll attached.

You can Cast the Spell from the scroll as part of a Spellstrike, provided the spell is one you could normally use with Spellstrike. You can’t Cast the Spell in any other way while it’s affixed, though you can use Affix a Talisman again to remove the scroll and use it as a normal—if a bit crumpled—scroll.

name: Student of the Staff
description:
You’ve studied the staff extensively to learn the hidden capabilities of your chosen weapon. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using a staff, you can apply the critical specialization effect of the club group. (If you use the critical specialization on a Spellstrike, the spell still affects the target even if you pushed the target out of reach.)

While you’re in Arcane Cascade stance, your staff gains the deadly d6 trait, with the damage from the deadly die being the same damage type as the extra damage from Arcane Cascade.

In addition, you can place property runes into a magic staff you prepare, even though a magic staff can’t typically hold property runes. You must first inscribe the property runes into your spellbook, using the same process as transferring a rune. The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. You can’t inscribe runes that can’t be placed on a non-magical staff, nor can you inscribe the shifting rune. When you prepare a staff, you can impart any number of property runes from your spellbook into the staff, up to the limit imposed by the staff’s weapon potency rune.

name: Subtle Shift
description: You’ve learned how to hide your meddling from the casters of spells you’re shifting. If your Arcana check when Shifting a Spell is greater than its caster’s Perception DC, you can prevent the caster from learning the effects of the shift you’re attempting to apply. On a critical success, they don’t become aware that you’re applying a shift at all (although the effect of the shift might still give you away).

name: Summoner Dedication
description:
You’ve formed a bond with an eidolon, an entity that manifests in a physical body only through their link to your life force. You gain an eidolon as well as the Manifest Eidolon activity. Due to your tenuous link, you can’t gain or use tandem actions. Because you don’t have Act Together, only you or your eidolon can perform an exploration activity at one time.

Your eidolon is trained in unarmed attacks and unarmored defense, and shares your proficiency rank for Perception, saving throws, and skill checks. Choose an eidolon type. You become trained in your eidolon’s listed skills. For each of those skills that you’re already trained in, you become trained in a different skill of your choice. Your eidolon’s initial attributes are reduced. Instead of starting with a +4 attribute modifier in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other, your eidolon starts with a +3 in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other attribute. They otherwise gain the statistics listed for an eidolon of that type.

At 5th level, the eidolon’s attribute modifier that was reduced to +3 increases to +4, before applying attribute boosts. At levels 5, 10, 15, and 20, your eidolon also gets four attribute boosts, which follow the same rules as yours.

Basic Summoner Spellcasting, Basic Synergy, Expert Combat Eidolon, Initial Eidolon Ability

name: Summoner's Call
description:
In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side. Your eidolon teleports to an open space adjacent to you.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

name: Supreme Spellstrike
description: For you, it is almost effortless to combine spells and attacks into devastating combinations. You’re permanently quickened. You can use your extra action only to Strike or to recharge Spellstrike.

name: Surging Smash
description: Lashing forward, your weapon becomes an extension of your nexus, washing your enemies in a torrent of magical fury. Make a melee Strike. Regardless of the result, you create a 30- foot cone of magical energy dealing 3d6 force damage with a basic Fortitude save against your nexus DC. You choose the cone’s direction, but its first square must be a square in the target of your strike’s space. A creature that critically fails the save is also knocked prone. The force damage increases by 1d6 at 8th level and every 2 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Surprising Leap
description:
Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe. Your eidolon makes a Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump and attempts one melee Strike at any point during that jump. Immediately after the Strike, your eidolon falls to the ground if they’re in the air, even if they haven’t reached the maximum distance of their jump. If the distance your eidolon falls is no more than the height of their jump, your eidolon takes no damage and lands upright.

When attempting a High Jump or Long Jump during a Surprising Leap, determine the jump distance using Long Jump’s rules, and change your eidolon’s maximum distance to double their Speed.

name: Sustaining Steel
description:
You pull magic from the surrounding area into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy. You regain Hit Points equal to the triggering spell’s rank and roll to end any persistent void damage you have. If you’re in the Arcane Cascade stance, the healing is equal to double the spell’s rank.

If the spell had the vitality or void trait, any persistent vitality or void damage you have ends automatically, and you can change the damage type from Arcane Cascade to vitality or void if you wish. (Vitality damage typically damages only undead or other creatures with void healing.)

name: Swiping Trace
description:
You prepare a rune on the end of your weapon so that it transfers to your enemies. Make a melee Strike and compare the attack roll to the AC of up to two enemies within your melee reach. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. You can Trace a Rune on each creature you hit and deal damage to, but they must be the same rune. A Swiping Trace counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

If you’re using a weapon with the sweep trait, its bonus applies to your Swiping Trace attack.

name: System Override
description: When someone takes control of your consciousness or your body, you innately resist their domination with everything you have. At the beginning of your turn, if you have the controlled condition, you must attempt a DC 11 flat check. On a success, you ignore the controlled condition for 1 round.

name: Tandem Movement
description: You and your eidolon move together. You each use a single action to Stride. Either of you that has the corresponding movement type can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.

name: Tandem Strike
description: You and your eidolon each attack, seamlessly targeting the same foe without interfering with each other’s movements. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike, and then you make a melee Strike against the same creature. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both attacks have been made.

name: Temporary Possession
description: You temporarily possess of a creature's body. You learn the temporary possession grave spell.

name: Tender Ministrations
description: Your gentle magic eases even the most skittish of souls, a gift that almost guarantees you popularity among parents and farmers alike. If your next action is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets a single creature, you can reduce the target’s frightened condition by 1. If the target is an animal, you can also attempt to counteract an effect imposing the confused or fleeing condition.

name: Terrifying Invocation
description: You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name. You attempt to Demoralize a single target within 30 feet and then Invoke one Rune upon that target. You don't take a penalty to your check if the creature doesn't understand your language.

name: The Hallowed Dead
description:
While many necromancers seek unholy and perverse power, you have dedicated yourself to the practice of necromancy to stop the creation of permanent undead and the corruption of souls. You and your thralls gain the holy trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the holy trait and deal 1 additional spirit damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: “purposefully create undead to do undue harm.”

Hallowed Earth

name: The Taste of Magic
description: Each working of magic has a unique scent and frequency of vibration. You have trained yourself to recognize the minute differences in magics, as if distinguishing between different odors. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This scent can only detect creatures, items, and effects that are currently under the effect of a spell or have the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait. In addition, you may use Arcana, Occultism, Nature, or Religion instead of Survival to Track creatures you could sense with this ability.

name: The Unholy Dead
description:
You have turned your necromancy against the divine powers that seek to stop you from achieving your unholy goals. You and your thralls gain the unholy trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the unholy trait and deal 1 additional spirit damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: “destroy undead of no harm to you.”

Corrupted Ground

name: The World Devours
description:
The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a 20-foot burst, the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a 30-foot burst or larger. If you use this ability while your waking world already has a creature grabbed or devoured, that creature is automatically freed. If your waking world ends, any creature affected by this ability is automatically freed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.

Failure The creature takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and slowed 1, and takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect. A creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC; in addition to the normal checks to Escape, it can attempt a Nature check. If it Escapes, it is returned to the area where it was when grabbed. A creature with a burrow Speed can Escape automatically and move up to its burrow Speed as part of that action.

name: The World Whispers
description: Your waking world tells you about the unseen creatures it holds. You Seek in your waking world. If you succeed or critically succeed against a creature that was undetected by you, you Point Out the creature to any allies in your waking world. When you Point Out the creatures in this way, the action does not have the visual or manipulate traits, but still requires your allies to be able to hear and understand you.

name: Thick Skin
description: You thicken your skin by adding an impossibly thin layer of dense muscle directly under the surface. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. The first time each round you destroy a thrall, each enemy adjacent to you must succeed at a Fortitude save against your spell DC or become sickened 1.

name: Thrall Charger
description: You gain the thrall charge grave cantrip, allowing you to more aggressively use your undead servants.

name: Towering Size
description: Your eidolon becomes even bigger. They become Huge, instead of Large, and the reach on all of their attacks increases to 15 feet.

name: Tracing Studies
description:
You can now create runes in the midst of combat. You gain the Trace Rune action.

Trace Rune [single action] or [two actions] (concentrate, magical, manipulate, runesmith) Requirements You're holding or wearing an artisan's toolkit; Effect You apply one rune to an adjacent target matching the rune's usage entry. You can have any number of runes traced at a time, but each rune remains only until the end of your next turn. If you spend 2 actions to Trace a Rune, you draw the rune in the air, causing it to appear on a target within 30 feet.

name: Tracing Trance
description: Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct. You become quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Trace a Rune (including to supply 1 action if using the 2-action version of Trace Rune). Focused on the act of creation, you can’t use invocation actions this turn.

name: Translocational Adept
description: Your command over teleportation grows. You can cast translocate as an innate 4th-rank occult spell once per day. At 14th level, the spell is heightened to 5th rank. When you cast translocate this way, you can Part the Veil as a free action when you arrive at your destination, even if you wouldn’t normally meet its requirements.

name: Transpose
description:
You switch places with your eidolon. You each teleport to the other’s position.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

name: Transpose Etching
description: With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere. You move any one of your runes within 30 feet to a different eligible target within 30 feet.

name: True Transmogrification
description: You transmogrify your eidolon each day. During your daily preparations, you can swap out any number of your evolution feats, each for a different evolution feat of an appropriate level for which you meet the prerequisites. These swaps last until your next daily preparations.

name: Twin Eidolon
description:
You can transform to match your eidolon. When you Manifest your Eidolon, you can call upon their powers to transform yourself into a duplicate until your eidolon unmanifests. You can’t use this if you Manifest your Eidolon in an unusual way, such as Meld into Eidolon. While using Twin Eidolon, you use your eidolon’s statistics other than your own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma attribute modifiers, including their evolutions. You can’t cast spells (except spells your eidolon could cast), Activate or otherwise benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, or use other actions they can’t perform. Any of their spells you cast with limited uses count against your eidolon’s uses. You can Manifest your Eidolon again to end this effect.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

name: Unbounded Invocations
description: Your words can shake the very foundations of the world. When you Invoke Runes, you can invoke any number of runes within 30 feet instead of just two.

name: Undead Creator
description: You’ve learned the unholy art of creating permanent undead creatures. You learn the create undead ritual. You can cast this ritual without a secondary caster. When you do, you must fulfill any requirements for the secondary caster, and you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that secondary caster.

name: Undead Familiar
description:
You gain the ability to raise an undead familiar who will serve you as your loyal and sometimes expendable partner as you explore your necromantic magic. You gain a familiar. It has the undead trait instead of the animal trait and is immune to bleed, death effects, disease, mental, and poison. You can choose only one familiar ability per day for this familiar instead of two, and you can’t choose an ability that changes the creature’s trait (such as construct or dragon). Additionally, this familiar can be targeted by spells and abilities that target your thralls. If you destroy your familiar, you can raise them back to undeath during your next daily preparations.

Enhanced Undead Familiar

name: Undead Hunter
description:
You were created by a Nexian mage specifically for the purpose of fighting undead, and you are infused with vitality magic. You gain vitality lash as an innate divine cantrip.

Enhancement You can infuse your attacks with vitality. You can cast infuse vitality as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, targeting only yourself.

name: Unerring Runic Attraction
description: Your runes act as beacons for your arrows and bolts. Make a ranged Strike against a foe you’re aware of that’s currently bearing a rune and within your first range increment. The ammunition homes in on your target, even going around corners. Your Strike doesn’t require line of sight, ignores the target’s concealed condition, and ignores all circumstance bonuses to AC granted from cover and shields.

name: Unfetter Eidolon
description: You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side. You learn the unfetter eidolon link spell.

name: Unholy Resurrection
description: You can bring back the recently deceased, but at what cost? You add raise dead to your dirge and can cast it as an occult spell. However, when you Cast this Spell, the returned creature gains the undead trait. (The creature knows it will return as undead when it decides whether to return.) Only powerful magic such as a wish ritual can return the target to true life again. You gain an additional spell slot each day at your highest rank of necromancer spell slots. You can prepare only the raise dead spell in this slot.

name: Vampiric Spell
description: Your magic drains the life from your enemy. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the initial damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage from the spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Veil Dancer Dedication
description:
You’re able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice. You gain the Part the Veil action.

Part the Veil [two actions] (concentrate, magical) Requirements You are not observed by any enemies; Effect You phase yourself into the interstices, veiling yourself from physical reality. You become concealed. You can use this concealment to Hide or Sneak as your disassociation from reality makes you difficult to focus on. If you use a hostile action, this effect ends after the action is complete; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute.

Aerial Flash, Afterimage, Contingency Leap, Dart Between, Dimensional Pilfer, Fade Presence, Gossamer Blade, Hush, Interstitial Escape, Translocational Adept, Veil of Eternity, Warp Path

name: Veil of Eternity
description: You can remain within the interstices of reality longer. Your Part the Veil has a duration of one hour, though it still ends if you take a hostile action. Additionally, while Avoiding Notice during exploration, you can also Part the Veil.

name: Versatile Spellstrike
description: You can channel the entire realm of possibilities of your spellbook into an attack. Once during your daily preparations, you can use a spell slot to hold that infinite potential, rather than using it to prepare a spell. When you make a Spellstrike, you can expend this special spell slot to immediately prepare and cast a spell from your spellbook at 2 ranks lower than the slot’s rank. (As normal for preparing spells, you can use a spell of an even lower rank, heightening it accordingly.) You don’t have any spell prepared in that slot until you cast from that slot.

name: Vibration Sense
description: Your eidolon gains tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. If aquatic, they instead gain wavesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. If amphibious, they gain both.

name: Vital Compound Invocation
