description: You can invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy to restore flesh. You Invoke two Runes—one must be a divine rune, and one must be a primal rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature that’s within 30 feet of both invoked runes regains Hit Points equal to 5 + double your level.

name: Void Siphon (Necromancer)
description: You open your body to absorb void energy. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering void damage. After you take the triggering damage, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 round.

name: Wake and Tremble
description:
You have the world wake with a great convulsion. All other creatures in the area when you Rouse the World must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls and lands prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also becomes sickened 1.

name: Warp Path
description: You fold space around you, transporting yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. When you arrive, make a melee Strike against one creature within your weapon's reach. On a critical success, you remain veiled until the end of your next turn or until you take another hostile action.

name: Weighty Impact
prerequisites: Your eidolon has an unarmed attack with the shove or trip trait
description: Your eidolon hurls enemies to the ground or across the battlefield. Choose one of the eidolon’s unarmed attacks that has the shove or trip trait. The attack gains the other trait as well, and your eidolon gains the Knockdown and Push actions for that attack.

name: Whirlwind Spell
description:
You combine the might of a multitarget spell with a whirling flurry of attacks. You use Spellstrike, making a melee Strike against each enemy within your reach instead of against one enemy. If your spell can affect multiple targets or normally has an area, your spell affects all foes you hit, not just the first target, up to the spell’s normal maximum targets. If you Strike more enemies than the spell could target, choose which foes are affected by the spell. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty but doesn’t increase your penalty until you’ve made all your attacks.

You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the targets to determine the area.

name: Widespread Fascination
description:
You are not content to restrict yourself to one field. Instead, you've studied a wider range of necromantic magic to better expand your horizons and explore your unscrupulous fascinations. You learn the grave spell for a grim fascination other than yours. You must have access to that fascination. Access can be gained from independent study or sought-out tutelage.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different grave spell each time.

name: Wings of Bone and Sinew
description:
You can harness the power of death to craft wings from bones and a thin membrane of flesh. You destroy a thrall within 30 feet, fusing it with your body and shaping it into gruesome, bony wings. You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. You can Dismiss these wings.

At 16th level, this action loses its frequency and gains an unlimited duration.

name: Words, Fly Free
description: Just because your runes are tattooed on your very body doesn’t mean they need to remain there. You fling your hand out, the rune from your Runic Tattoo flowing down it and flying through the air in a crescent. You Trace the Rune onto all targets within a 15-foot cone that match the rune’s usage requirement. The rune then returns to you, faded.

name: World Rouser Dedication
description:
You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge. You gain the Rouse the World action.

As your ability to converse with the world grows, you can call on it to help you in other ways, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your world rouser DC.

Rouse the World [single action] (concentrate, primal) The flora, fauna, and elements in a 10- foot burst within 30 feet stir, aiding you and your allies and whispering in your ear. This area is known as your waking world. While in your waking world, you and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics and Acrobatics checks, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Recall Knowledge about creatures and hazards in the area. The effect lasts for 10 minutes, but you can Dismiss it. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain this ability to increase the burst’s size by 10 feet. You can Rouse the World in only one area at a time; if you use this ability again, the first area returns to normal.

A Hush Falls Over the World, All Returns to Slumber, Awake With a Roar, Come in From the Wilderness, Dust Cloud, Nature's Embrace, Sheltering Hand, The World Devours, The World Whispers, Wake and Tremble

name: Writing on the Wall
prerequisites: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
description:
You place hidden messages written in a runic cipher of your devising. You can cast embed message once per day as an innate spell. The rank of this spell is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least expert in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine). When you cast embed message, instead of choosing a language you know for the message’s text and speech, you can choose to have the message be text only, written in a runic code that only you know. You can impart the knowledge of this code to up to 5 creatures over the course of 10 minutes; they retain this knowledge indefinitely, but you can devise a new runic code for subsequent messages you wish to be encoded.

A creature can Decipher the Writing of your runic code using the same skill associated with the chosen tradition against your class DC.

name: Zombie Horde
description: You raise what seems like an endless torrent of walking corpses. You learn the zombie horde grave spell.
